tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ bishiṣ+ṭastabaḥ/ bod skad du/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i bstod pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag ni ston pa gzhan spangs nas// bcom ldan khyod la skyabs mchis pa// de ci'i slad du zhe na khyod// skyon mi mnga' la yon tan ldan// gang phyir 'jig rten skyon la dga'// yon tan 'dzin la zhan pas na// skyon yang yon tan ltar mthong nas// gzhan la skyabs su mchis par 'gyur// khyab 'jug dbang phyug la sogs pa// de la skye bo dga' dad pas// de yi yon tan gang bsgrags pa// khyed kyi bstan pa de dag skyon// lha chen khros pas mda' gcig gis// grong khyer sum brtsegs bsregs zhes grag /khyod kyis ye shes mda' chen gyis// khro ba'i sems nyid nges par bsregs// lha chen gyis ni 'dod pa dag /bsregs nyes pas na phyir yang drangs// khyod kyi ye shes zhugs kyis ni// 'dod pa rtsad bcad bsregs nas bton// lha chen thig le mchog ma la// chags pa skyes pas gdong bzhi phyung*// bdud kyi bu mos sgeg pa yis// khyod kyi ba spu'i rtse ma g.yos// lha chen phyed ni chung ma bas// ngur pa yis kyang thub ma lags// khyod ni bde bar bgyid pa yi// 'dod pa nyid kyis rmongs ma gyur// 'khor lo mdung thung can dag gis// bdud stobs de las rgyal ma nus// khyod ni 'khor lo mdung med par// byams pa'i mtshon gang lags pas rgyal// rgan pos khyab 'jug mda' yis bsnun// lha chen mgrin pa sngo gyur pas// lha 'di gnyis la gnod bgyid mchis// mgon khyod gnod bgyid bral ba lags// khyab 'jug mi thung gzugs bsgyur nas// g.yo thabs kyis ni stobs ldan bslus// khyod ni g.yo yang mkhyen gyur la// gzhan dag la yang bslu mi mdzad// mgon khyod rdzu 'phrul rnam 'phrul ba// rmad byung gang gis mthong ba des// khyab 'jug 'jig rten gsum brgal ba// 'phye bo mchi ba bzhin du mthong*// gzhon nu tshangs par spyod pa na// drug ldan ma dang lhan cig spyod// khyod kyis 'khrig pa'i sbyor ba bdun// thal ba bzhin du bgyis par gyur// tshangs sogs 'jig rten 'byin pa po// bdag cag yin par smra zhes grag

/de nyid gzigs khyod 'jig rten dang*// de yang las las skyes zhes bstan// brgya byin gyis ni bshol med ma// mthong nas 'dod pas rmongs zhes grag /dpa' khyod 'dod pa nyid kyis ni// ma rmongs slad du btsun mo btang*// sgra gcan lag pas zla ba yang*// dbang med par ni mid pa lags// mnga' brnyes khyod la sems can gang*// dbang med bgyid pa de ma mchis// mi dbang dga' byed gos sred sogs// nags tshal nas ni phyir yang mchis// bde gshegs khyod ni dben pa yi// bdud rtsis ngoms pas phyir mi byon// mchod sbyin la ni phyugs 'gums par// drang srong rnams ni smra zhes grag /sdig med khyod kyis grog ma la'ang*// gnod pa bgyid par rjes ma gnang*// gzhan dag rang don mchod sbyin la// gzhan gyi srog gis sbyin sreg byed// gzhan gyi don du khyod gcig pu// rang gi srog gis sbyin sreg mdzad// drang srong dmod me mi bzad pas// skye bo mang po bsregs par gyur// khyod kyi ye shes me yis ni// skye bo rnams kyi skye rgyu bsregs// drang srong dmod pa grub pa las// dka' thub grub par rjes su dpag /mgon khyod thugs rje grub pa las// dka' thub grub par rjes su dpag /lha chen 'dod pa can gyi mtshan/ drang srong rnams kyi dmod pas lhung*// khyed kyis phung khrol mtha' dag gi /rtsa ba 'dod pa nyid lhung bgyis// gling las skyes sogs phal cher ni// gzhan gyis gang smras smra bar bgyid// khyod kyis thun mong ma yin chos// rang gis thugs su chud nas ston// mu stegs can gyi rig byed tshig /dben pa kho nar smra ba bgyid// khyod kyis bsgrags nas seng ge yi// sgra yis chos dag ston par mdzad// grangs can bha ra dwa dza ni// de nyid mthong yang dpyid ldan la// yongs su chags kyi gtso khyod kyi// slob ma'ang bud med nyid ma chags// 'ug pa pas ni dman pa las// khyad par can la sbyin zhes bstan// mgon po khyod ni thugs rje yis// khyi la'ang sbyin par bya zhes gsungs// lus kyi dka' thub bgyis pa yis// mdud pa 'jig par gcer bus 'tshal// khyod ni thugs kyi dka' thub kyis// mdud pa 'jig par bzhed pa lags// rtog ge pa dag dngos po rnams// ltos pa med par grub par 'tshal// tshig dbang khyod kyis cung zad kyang*// mi ltos med ces legs par gsungs// ne tsos nyi ma brtol nas ni// thar pa mchis par bshad ces grag

/khyod ni mya ngan 'das brnyes la// gang du yang ni gshegs ma mchis// thar pa rgyud gzhan bskyed pa dang*/ ne tsos lam gzhan song bar gyur// khyod nyid lam gang nas gshegs pa/ de nyid nas ni slob ma'ang mchis// khyab 'jug dag gis bud med ni// stong phrag drug cu yongs bzung gyur// ston pa 'jig rten 'das khyod la// bdag gi med cing yongs 'dzin med// kā shī mdzes dga' mo la ni// rgyas pa yongs chags rnam par gyur// khyod khab bzhugs na'ang phung khrol ba'i// gdon gyis dbang po rmongs ma 'gyur// rgyas pa 'dod gdung g.yen spyo bas// bud med kyi ni rdog pas bsnun// khyod ni khyim par bzhugs na yang// phyir zhing 'khrug par 'gyur ba med// dga' byed chung ma'i don gyi phyir// rgya 'tsho'i pha rol son ces grag /khyod kyis bud med stong phrag ni// brgyad cu spangs nas nags su gshegs// rna can 'thab dka' la sogs la// khyab 'jug gis ni gnod pa brtsams// sems can rnams la phan bzhed pa// khyod kyis srog kyang btang bar mdzad// khyab 'jug gis ni sgyu byas nas// gom gsum gyis phrogs gang yin pa'i// sa de nges par thar bzhed pa// khyod kyis rtswa bzhin btang bar gyur// dga' byed srog gcod byed pa'i mdas// 'jig rten rgyal rigs med byas nas// grags pa thob pa gang yin de// khyed kyi bstan la grags pa min// sgra ngan dang ni skya bseng dag /gang gi phyir ni g.yul bkye ba'i// dpal de khyod kyis 'khri shing ni// gdug pa bzhin du spangs nas gshegs// khyod kyi bstan pa rnyed pa na// thang shing nags na lha chen po// rnal 'byor dbang phyug spyod pa po// de ni mi shes spyod par bas// dbang po bshol med byi bo zhes// bram ze da dung bar du sgrogs// khyod kyis 'bras bu mchog brnyes pa'i// grags pa brgya byin sgrogs par gyur// khyab 'jug dag ni nag bkra bos// bred 'thoms gyur nas kun gtong gi

/khri yi 'og tu zhugs par gyur*// gtso khyod kun tu bsnyengs mi mnga'// skye dgu'i bdag po rang nyid kyi// bu mo dang ni 'khrig ces thos// thub pa khyod kyi slob ma yang*// tshangs par spyod pa skyon ma mchis// bram ze rnams ni dge sdig dag /sbyin pa len cing 'pho bar smra// khyod kyi byas pa chud mi za// ma byas pa dang phrad med gsungs// ser skyas bdag gi mtshan nyid ni// shes dang ldan par rab tu brtags// khyod kyi de ltar yin na bdag /mi rtag nyid dang ldan zhes bstan// gzegs zan gyis ni shes las bdag /gzhan dang khyad par yongs su brjod// khyod kyis de ni shes med na// shing dang 'dra bar thal 'gyur gsungs// gcer bus lus kyi tshad bzhin du// srog ni zhum dang rgyas par smra// khyod kyis de ni phyogs gcig phyir// rnam par 'jig par 'gyur zhes gsungs// bram zes 'gro ba rnams kyi rgyu// skyes bu rtag pa yin zhes brtags// khyod kyis rtag pa zhes bya ba'i// rgyu ni ci yang med ces gsungs// bdag nyid chen po dug can pa'i// sras po stong phrag drug cu dag /ser skyas bltas pa tsam gyis bsregs// de la'ang khyed ni thugs rje mdzad// ser skya de nyid rig pas ni// gtso las 'gro ba skye bar bshad// khyod kyis 'gro ba'i skye ba ni// nyon mongs pa las 'byung bar bsgrags// ser skya la sogs thar pa yis// bdag ni srid pa'i rgyu zhes zer// khyod ni zhi bar gshegs gyur nas// zhugs gum lta bu bgrang du med// mu stegs byed pa kha cig ni// thar pa 'gro dang ldan zhes smra// gang la 'gro yod de 'khor ba// khyod kyis thugs su chud nas bstan// gcer bus kun dga' ra ba sogs// rtsig pa sdig pa'i rgyu zhes zer// thams cad mkhyen pa khyed nyid ni// de nyid bsod nams rgyu zhes gsungs// lus las lus gzhan dag tu ni// phra ba'i srog ni 'pho zhes grag

/khyod kyis lus las gzhan gyur pa'i// srog ni yod pa min zhes gsungs// khros pas g.yul ngor bsad na ni// bde 'gror 'gyur zhes rgyas pa zer// mgon po khyod kyis gnas skabs de'i// sems ni ngan 'gro yin zhes gsungs// skya bseng bu ni brjod byas na// bsod nams 'gyur zhes so sor smra// gang zhig bgrod min bgrod byed pa// de dag khyod kyi bstan la smad// skem byed dbang po nye dbang po// drag po la sogs 'jigs pa dang*// bsdigs phyir mtshon cha rtag tu thogs// khyod bsnyengs bral zhing bsdigs mi mdzad// khyod ni sus kyang mi bsnyengs la// su la'ang bsdigs par mi mdzad pas// khyod nyid gcig pu mtshon mi bsnams// des na 'gro ba rnams las 'phags// smra po nyon mongs bcas pa'i tshig /rig byed la sogs tshig dag ni// phal cher ltag 'og 'gal ba lags// khyod kyi thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung*// gzhan gyi bstan bcos gzhan dag ni// phal cher snga phyi 'gal ba lags// khyod nyid kyi ni gzhung lugs dag /thog ma bar mthar skyon ma mchis// chos 'dod pa dag dmangs rigs la// blo gros sbyin par bya min ste// khyod ni gdol pa rnams la yang*// thugs rjes dam chos ston par mdzad// ljon shing bzang po rnams spangs nas// ngan pa la ni su zhig brten// 'dod chags bral brnyes khyed bzhugs na// mkhas pa su zhig ston gzhan 'dud// ser skyas yul rnams la spyad bzhin// ye shes 'gyur mchi sdig bral ba// khyod kyis kun nas nyon mongs la// thar pa ga la yod ces gsungs// bsod nams byas pa'i tshogs dag ni// sems can rnams la yongs bsngo bar// bcom ldan khyod kyis gang gsungs pa// de bzhin bstan bcos las ma bshad// lha rten dang ni mchod sbyin la// sems can gsod par byed pa gang*// 'jig rten pa ni chos su 'tshal// khyod kyi bstan la de dag smad// gang zhig srog chags la rtag gnod// de la chos nyid ga la yod// gtso bo khyod kyis rang nyid kyi// srog gis sems can legs par bsrungs// shākya'i rgyal rigs 'khrungs khyod kyis// gang zhig bden dang mi slu dang*// tshangs par spyod dang dul ba dang*// brtse ldan dam chos lags par dgongs// rig byed mtha' la 'byams pas kyang*// g.yul ngor dgra mngon 'ongs bsad ces// 'jig rten smra yi khyod kyis ni// dgra la'ang snying rje bya zhes gsungs// gzhon nus rang gi zhang po la// mdung gis bsnun zhes bka' mchid gda'// dpa' bo khyod kyis nyon mongs pa'i// drwa ba shes rab mtshon gyis dral// khyab 'jug gis ni rang nyid kyi// slas kyang yongs su bskyab ma nus// gtso bo khyod kyis sems can kun// bskyab pa'i don du rtag tu btson// rgan pos sbyar ba'i 'jigs shes nas// khyab 'jug gis ni bcom brlag btang*// thub pa khyod la bsnyengs bgyid gang*// sems can de ni 'ga' ma mchis// khyab 'jug gis ni gnyen 'dun dag

/le lan gyis ni gtugs par gyur// khyod kyis gnyen 'dun thams cad ni// 'khor ba las ni rnam par sgrol// mu stegs can gyi gzhung lugs la// ji lta ji ltar rnam bsams pa// de lta de ltar mgon khyod la// bdag gi sems ni dad par gyur// de ltar thams cad mkhyen min pa'i// grub mtha'i skyon gyi brlag sems ldan// bsam brlag rnams kyis skyon med pa'i// ston pa khyod kyang mi mthong ngo*// 'jig rten lha dang bram ze dang*// rig byed shākya 'di dag ces// sdang bar smra ba rang skyon nyid// ci phyir sems par byed ce na// gang slad khyod kyi bstan pa ni// bde bas bde nyid thob bgyid pa// de slad smra ba'i seng khyod kyi// gzhung lugs la ni 'gro 'di dga'// khyod kyi yon tan yang dag pa// rnam pa 'di ltar rab brjod pas// bdag gis bsod nams gang thob des// 'gro ba'i 'jig rten khyod 'drar shog /mgon po khyad par 'phags bstod pa// bton pa dag gis dge bsags pa// gang yin des ni 'gro ba kun// byang chub lam la gzhol gyur cig /khyad par du 'phags pa'i bstod pa slob dpon mtho btsun grub rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// rgya gar gyi mkhan po sarba dzñā de wa dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de rin chen mchog gis bsgyur// slad kyis ban de dpal brtsegs rak+ṣi tas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o/// /

༄༅// sems dpa' chen po khu nu bla ma bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan rin po che'i zhal snga nas gsungs pa'i khyad par 'phags bstod kyi rtsa 'grel bzhugs so// ༄༅// bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// rgya gar skad du/ bishiṣ+ṭa stabaḥ/ bod skad du/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i bstod pa/ bstan bcos 'di rgya gar gyi legs sbyar saṃskṛta lha'i skad du bishiṣ+ṭa stab/ bod dang bod chen po sogs su yod pa'i brda rnams las legs sbyar chos mthun gtsang ma'i skad du/ khyad par 'phags pa'i bstod pa/ skad gnyis shan sbyar na/ bishiṣ+ṭa ni khyad par 'phags pa'i/ stab ni bstod pa zhes bya'o// mtshan don cung zad 'grel na/ 'o skol gyi ston pa thugs rje can ni mu stegs pa'i ston pa dang lha dang drang srong rnams las gsang gsum gyi yon tan mchog gis khyad par rmad du byung zhing 'phags pa'i gnas tshul shes nas yid dga' zhing dad pas bstod pa zhes bya'o// zhar byung 'gyur phyag ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// ji ltar sngon gyi bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis thugs bskyed pa nas bzung ste spangs rtogs mthar son pa de bzhin du skyabs gnas mthar thug dag pa gnyis ldan gyi ngo bor gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes lo tsā bas 'gyur mthar phyin pa sogs kyi slad du mdzad pa'o// bdag ni ston pa gzhan spangs nas// bcom ldan khyod la skyabs mchis pa// de ci'i slad du zhe na khyod// skyon mi mnga' la yon tan ldan// zhes pa ni/ mtho btsun grub rje bdag ni mu stegs kyi ston pa drang srong rgyas pa dang*/ ser skya/ gzegs gzan/ gau ta ma la sogs pa gzhan spangs nas/ skyon thams cad bcom zhing yon tan thams cad ldan pa khyed la srid zhi'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i skyabs su 'ongs pa'am mchis pa lags so// khyed la skyabs su song ba de rgyu mtshan ci'i slad du yin zhe na/ ston pa thugs rje can khyod ni bdud bzhi'am sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa zad par spangs pas skyon mi mnga' la dpal dang grags pa la sogs pa'am stobs bcu'i bdag nyid/

rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes sogs khyad par du 'phags pa'i yon tan kun dang ldan pa yin pa de'i slad du'am phyir du'o// skyon mi mnga' la yon tan kun ldan de lta na gang gi phyir 'jig rten gyi skye bo phal mo ches de la mi dad cing rjes su mi 'jug par/ ston pa dang bstan pa 'di las phyi rol du gyur pa ci yin zhe na/ gang phyir 'jig rten skyon la dga'// yon tan 'dzin la zhan pas na// skyon yang yon tan ltar mthong nas// gzhan la skyabs su mchis par 'gyur// zhes pa ni/ 'jig rten gyi skye bo phal mo che rnams ni dam min gyi las la ngang gis gzhol zhing skyon yongs su 'dzin pa la mngon par dga' ba'i phyir dang*/ dam pa dang dam pa'i yon tan 'dzin pa la shin tu zhan pa de lta bas na 'ching ba kun gyi lha dang ston pa sems can gyi srog la 'tshe ba chos su smra ba la sogs pa'i skyon la yang yon tan yin pa ltar rlom zhing mthong nas/ lha dang drang srong gzhan dang gzhan dag la skyabs su mchis par gyur te/ de skad du'ang bzhi brgya pa las/ phal mo che ge mi rnams ni// dam pa ma yin phyogs yongs 'dzin// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// skyon dang ldan pa'i lha sogs la yon tan can du ji ltar lta ba yin zhe na/ khyab 'jug dbang phyug la sogs pa// de la skye bo dga' dad pas// de yi yon tan gang bsgrags pa// khyed kyi bstan pa de dag skyon// zhes pa ni/ khyab 'jug gam kriṣ+ṇa dang dbang phyug ste rtag zhi ba tshangs pa dang gdong drug la sogs pa rnams kyi lha de dang de la mu stegs can gyi skye bo log pa'i lam du 'phyan pa rnams dga' zhing dad pa dang ldan pas/ khyab 'jug gis dmag 'thab tu bcug pa dang*/ dbang phyug gis grong khyer sum brtsegs bcom pa sogs de dang de yi yon tan gang dang gang bsgrags pa de thams cad/ mtha' klas pa'i 'gro ba rnams zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su mdzad pa khyed kyi bstan pa zab mo mthong zhing rtogs pa'i gang zag la ni/

lha chen de dag gi mthu dang rdzu 'phrul ji snyed pa skyon 'ba' zhig las yon tan gyi cha 'ga' yang ma mchis so// skyon ni su'i rgyud la yod kyang spang bya yin pas/ 'o na phyi rol pa'i lha dang drang srong dang ston pa skyon ldan las ston pa thugs rje can yon tan ji lta bus khyad par du 'phags she na/ 'og nas rgyas par bshad par bya ste/ zhe sdang med pa'i khyad par la bstod pa ni/ lha chen khros pas mda' gcig gis// grong khyer sum brtsegs bsregs zhes grag / khyod kyis ye shes mda' chen gyis// khro ba'i sems nyid nges par bsregs// zhes gsungs te/ lha min gyi grong khyer sum brtsegs su grags pa/ bar snang la rgyu zhing lha dang bcas pa'i srog la 'tshe ba na/ lha chen dbang phyug shin tu khros pa'i mda' gcig gis lha min grong khyer sum brtsegs bsregs shing thal bar brlags so zhes de'i yon tan du grags la/ thub dbang khyed kyis ni bdag med rtogs pa'i ye shes rnam par mi rtog pa'i mda' chen gyis skyon gyi nang nas dman shos khong khro'i sems nyid nges par bsregs shing*/ slar mi skye ba'i chos can du byas so// de yang mdo las/ dge slong dag /khro ba spongs shig dang*/ khyed phyir mi ldog pa'i gnya' bor 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs/ des na sangs rgyas kyi rjes su gzhug pa dag gis kun nas mnar sems pa'i zhe sdang dgra bo 'di 'joms pa'i thabs la brtson par gdams pa'ang yin no// 'dod chags med pa'i khyad par la bstod pa ni/ lha chen gyis ni 'dod pa dag /bsregs nyes pas na phyir yang drangs// khyod kyi ye shes zhugs kyis ni// 'dod pa rtsad bcad bsregs nas bton// zhes gsungs te/ lha chen gyis ni tshangs par spyod pa'i dka' thub yun ring por spyad kyang 'dod pa dag bsregs nyes shing drung nas legs par ma 'byin pa'i dbang gis na bdud dga' rab dbang phyug gis mda' gsum 'phangs pas lha dbang phyug chen po u ma dang lhan cig phyir yang ste slar 'dod par zhugs shing drangs la/

sangs rgyas khyed kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i ye shes rnam par mi rtog pa'i zhugs kyis ni 'dod pa bag chags dang bcas pa rtsad nas bcad cing legs par bsregs nas slar mi skye ba'i chos can du mdzad nas bton to// 'dod chags bral ba'i khyad par la bstod pa ni/ lha chen thig le mchog ma la// chags pa skyes pas gdong bzhi phyung*// bdud kyi bu mos sgeg pa yis// khyod kyi ba spu'i rtse ma g.yos// zhes gsungs te/ lha chen po tshangs pa yis lha'i bu mo mtshar ba'i phul byung thig le mchog ma la chags pa skyes te gzir pa na/ bud med de shar phyogs sogs su 'gro ba na de la lta ba'i slad gdong bzhi phyung ba'am bton par byas la/ sangs rgyas dgra bcom khyed ni rdo rje gdan gyi byang chub ljon pa'i gam du rtswa'i gdan la mi g.yo ba'i skyil krung gis zhal shar du phyogs dran pa mngon du bzhag ste/ srod la bdud btul ba'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pa'i tshe lus med bdag po sogs bdud dmag bye ba sa ya drug gi glags rnyed ma nus shing*/ slar bdud kyi bu mo dga' ma dang sred ma skra 'dres ma sogs kyi sgeg cing sdug pa'i rnam 'gyur du ma bstan pa yis kyang thub dbang khyed kyi gsang gsum g.yo ba lta ci ba spu'i rtse mo tsam yang ma g.yos so// 'dod chags dang bral ba'i khyad par la bstod pa/ lha chen phyed ni chung ma bas// ngur pa yis kyang thub ma lags// khyod ni bde bar bgyid pa yi// 'dod pa nyid kyis rmongs ma gyur// ces gsungs te/ lha chen phyed dam dbang phyug ni 'dod chags ha cang dod drag pas rang gi chung ma mthong bas 'dod par gzir ba ma zad/ bya ngur pa khyo shug mthong ba yis kyang chags pas mnar ba bkag thub pa ma lags mod/ mgon po khyod ni zag bcas 'dod pa'i yon tan la rang dgar spyod pas bde bar bgyid pa yi thugs gzhar yang mi mnga' bas 'dod pa'i bde ba la chags pa nyid kyis rmongs shing gzir bar ma gyur to// zhes pas srid pa'i bde ba zag pa dang bcas pa las thugs dbyung zhing gtan gyi bde ba sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang don du gnyer dgos par gdams pa'o//

mtshon cha med pa'i khyad par la bstod pa ni/ 'khor lo mdung thung can dag gis// bdud stobs de las rgyal ma nus// khyod ni 'khor lo mdung med par// byams pa'i mtshon gang lags pas rgyal// zhes gsungs te/ mtshon cha thogs pa ni/ rang srung ba dang gzhan gzhom pa'i slad du 'dzin pa'i phyir 'khor lo can khyab 'jug dang mdung thung can gdong drug dag gis/ bdud kyi mthu stobs de las rgyal ma nus shing phas pham par byas pa dang*/ thub dbang khyod ni phyag na 'khor lo dang*/ mdung thung sogs mtshon cha gang yang med par/ bdud dmag bye ba sum cu rtsa drug gis rub kyang byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mtshon cha 'jam po gang lags pas bdud kyi g.yul las rgyal bar 'tshal lo// gnod pa med pa'i khyad par la bstod pa/ rgan pos khyab 'jug mda' yis bsnun// lha chen mgrin pa sngo gyur pas// lha 'di gnyis la gnod bgyid mchis// mgon khyod gnod bgyid bral ba lags// zhes gsungs te/ sngon rgan po zhes bya bas khyab 'jug gam kriṣ+ṇa la mda' yis bsnun te bsad pa dang*/ lha chen dbang phyug ni rgya mtsho nas thon pa'i dug kā la kū ḍa de mgrin par bzhag pas sngon po'am nag por gyur pas na/ lha chen po 'di gnyis la'ang mda' dang dug gis gnod pa bgyid pa gzhan mchis la/ mgon pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas khyod ni dug dang mtshon sogs kyis gnod pa dang zhe sdang sogs nyon mongs pa'i gnod pa bgyid pa gzhan bral ba lags so// g.yos mi slu ba'i khyad par la bstod pa/ khyab 'jug mi thung gzugs bsgyur nas// g.yo thabs kyis ni stobs ldan bslus// khyod ni g.yo yang mkhyen gyur la// gzhan dag la yang slu mi mdzad// ces gsungs te/ lha ma yin stobs ldan gyi lag nas sa chen po'i 'jig rten 'phrog pa'i slad du khyab 'jug gi mi'u thung gi gzugs sprul bsgyur byas nas gom pa gsum gyi g.yo thabs kyis ni lha min stobs ldan gang yin pa de bslus te sa 'og tu bcings par byas la/

ston pa thugs rje can khyod ni g.yo yang mkhyen par gyur mod de la brten nas pha rol gzhan dag la dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas gzhar yang bslu bar mi mdzad pa des na lhur len na ma 'ongs pa'i dus su rang nyid tshe rabs stong phrag du mar rang mgo 'khor bar 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ mgon po klus/ pha rol bslu ba lhur len pa// don du ji ltar rig ldan min// de yis tshe rabs stong phrag ni// mang por bdag nyid bslu bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// rdzu 'phrul gyi khyad par la bstod pa ni/ mgon khyod rdzu 'phrul rnam 'phrul ba// rmad byung gang gis mthong ba des// khyab 'jug 'jig rten gsum brgal ba// 'phye bo mchi ba bzhin du mthong*// 'jig rten gyi mgon po rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas khyod kyi cho 'phrul gsum gyi nang nas 'bar ba dang*/ 'khrug pa sogs kyi rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung rnam par 'phrul pa'i rmad byung gang gis mthong ba'i gang zag des/ khyab 'jug gi g.yo yis/ sa 'og /sa steng*/ ri bo sogs 'jig rten gsum brgal ba'i rdzu 'phrul bstan pa yang rkang med 'phye bo mchis pa bzhin du mthong ba yin no// tshangs spyod ma nyams pa'i khyad par la bstod pa/ gzhon nu tshangs par spyod pa na// drug ldan ma dang lhan cig spyod// khyod kyis 'khrig pa'i sbyor ba bdun// thal ba bzhin du bgyis par gyur// ces gsungs te/ lha yi dmag dpon gzhon nu gdong drug gang zhig nags su tshangs par spyad pa spyod cing tshul khrims la gnas pa'i tshe na yang*/ rang gi chung ma lha mo drug ldan ma dang lhan gcig spyod pa'i 'khrig pa'i sbyor ba rnams ma btang la/ bcom ldan 'dod chags bral ba khyod kyis khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ste/ dben pa nas bud med kyi gzugs la blta ba dang*/ sgra nyan pa dang rgyan cha la blta ba sogs 'khrig pa'i sbyor ba bdun po ma bsten par thal ba bzhin du dor bar bgyis te/

mdo las/ 'dod chags khyod kyi rtsa ba ni// shes te kun tu rtog las skye// khyod la rtog par ma gyur na// de tshe nga la mi 'byung ngo*// zhes sogs te 'dod pa gzhi med skye med sogs kyi ngo bor 'tshal bas tshangs spyod las gzhar yang ma nyams pas tshul khrims kyi phung po yongs su rdzogs par gyur to// tshangs sogs 'jig rten 'byin pa po// bdag cag yin par smra zhes grag / de nyid gzigs khyod 'jig rten dang*// de yang las las skyes zhes bstan// ces pa ste/ tshangs pa dang*/ dbang phyug /khyab 'jug la sogs pa rnams kyis snod bcud kyi 'jig rten sna tshogs pa 'di dag 'byin pa po bdag cag rang rang yin par smra ba ste khas len zhes gsungs nas/ de ltar byed pa po yin par mu stegs pa'i grub mtha' la grag ces ma rangs pa'i tshig gis zur ba dang*/ 'khor 'das kyi de nyid de gnas tshul ji lta ba bzhin gzigs pa'i ston pa mchog khyod nyid kyis skad cig gi rang dbang med par 'jig pa'i rten te gnas yin pas 'jig rten dang*/ der ma zad 'jig rten 'byin pa por 'dod pa'i tshangs sogs de yang rang rang gi rgyu sems pa bzang ngan sna tshogs pa'i las las skyes pa ma gtogs gzhan sus kyang 'byin du med pa ni/ dper na tshe 'di'i srid byus kyi shes yon rang gis ma bsgrubs par sus kyang 'byin du med pa dang 'dra zhing bstan pa ste gsungs so// ye shu'i chos lugs la'ang zhag bdun ring 'jig rten ye shu'i yab kyis byas zhes zer na yang rang lugs ni sa bcu pa'i mdo las/ khams gsum po 'di ni sems tsam mo zhes dang*/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pas kyang 'jug pa las/ sems nyid kyis ni sems can 'jig rten dang*// snod kyi 'jig rten shin tu sna tshogs 'god// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i grub mtha'i srog shing lta bu 'di las 'bras kyi rnam gzhag la nges pa rnyed pa dang*/

blang dor phyin ci ma log par gnang dgos pa'i tshul gsungs so// brgya byin gyis ni bshol med ma// mthong nas 'dod pas rmongs zhes grag / dpa' khyod 'dod pa nyid kyis ni// ma rmongs slad du btsun mo btang*// zhes pa ste/ mu stegs pa'i skyabs gnas lha dbang brgya byin gyis ni/ drang srong gau ta ma'i chung ma bshol med ma mthong nas 'dod cing chags pas ches rmongs pa ste ngo tsha med par gzhan gyi chung ma la log par zhugs par drang srong gis shes nas dmod pas mo mtshan stong lus la byung zhes grag ces zur za dang*/ bdud bzhi las rnam par rgyal ba'i dpa' bo ston pa mchog gis 'dod cing chags pa nyid kyis ni ma rmongs pa'am ma gzir ba'i slad du rang gi btsun mo yang mchil ma'i thal ba 'drar btang ba ste dor bar mdzad do// sgra gcan lag pas zla ba yang*// dbang med par ni mid pa lags//

mnga' brnyes khyod la sems can gang*// dbang med bgyid pa de ma mchis// zhes pa ste/ lha ma yin sgra gcan gyi lag pas nyi ma ma zad zla ba yang bzung ste rang dbang med par mgrin par mid pa ste btang ba lags/ mkhyen brtse nus gsum mam chos thams cad la mnga' brnyes pa ste dbang 'byor ba ston mchog khyod la sems can su gang la'ang dbang med gnod 'tshe bgyid pa de ni ma mchis so// de bzhin nga tshos kyang sa 'og 'bu srin la'ang dbang yod gtong mi rung gsungs so// mi dbang dga' byed gos sred sogs// nags tshal nas ni phyir yang mchis// bde gshegs khyod ni dben pa yi// bdud rtsis ngoms pas phyir mi byon// ces pa ste/ phyi pa'i mi dbang dga' byed rā ma ṇa dang*/ gos sred sogs sdug bsngal drag po phyogs re sogs kyis khyim las byung nas tshal sogs dben pa'i gnas re zhig brten yang*/ slar zag bcas kyi bde ba la chags nas khyim du phyir ldog pa yang mchis la/ spangs rtogs kyi bde ba mthar thug tu gshegs pa khyed kyis ni 'khor ba'i bde ba dang*/ bde ba'i rkyen rgyal srid dpal 'byor lha dang mnyam pa la'ang me yi 'obs ltar gnod pa'i bdag nyid khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du mthong nas/ rgyal srid 'phongs phyis pa'i rdo ltar bor te/ phyi nang gi dben pa gnyis la brten pa yi zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis thugs rgyud rab tu ngoms pas srid bde'i phyir pho brang du phyir mi byon/ mchod sbyin la ni phyugs 'gums par// drang srong rnams ni smra zhes grag / sdig med khyod kyis grog ma la'ang*// gnod pa bgyid par rjes ma gnang*// zhes/ mtho ris kyi don du mchod sbyin byed pa la ni phyugs 'gums par te rta dang ba glang mi la sogs gsod dgos pa/ drang srong rnams ni de ltar smra zhes de nyid tshad mar byed pa de dag gi grub mthar grag ces ma rangs pa dang*/

kha na ma tho ba'i sdig pa'i dri ma tsam yang med pa'i ston mchog khyed kyis tha na srog chags grog ma la'ang gnod pa mi bgyid par/ rang ma zad gdul bya la'ang rjes su ma gnang ba yin no// des na gzhan la gnod pa bya mi rung khyad par srog gcod mi rung*/ gzhan dag rang don mchod sbyin la// gzhan gyi srog gis sbyin sreg byed// gzhan gyi don du khyod gcig pu// rang gi srog gis sbyin sreg mdzad// ces/ ston pa gzhan dag rang nyid bde ba'i don du mchod sbyin la gzhan gyi shin tu gces pa'i srog bcad nas sha khrag gis sbyin sreg byed la/ sems can gzhan gyi don du thub pa mchog khyed gcig pu rang gi srog btang nas sha khrag gis sbyin sreg sogs mdzad pa ni/ 'khrungs rabs las/ sngon thub pa mchog rgyal po pad+ma zhes bya bar gyur pa'i tshe/ mnga' 'bangs la nad yams chen po byung nas mi mang po shi bas/ rgyal pos sman pa rnams bos 'di la cis phan dris pa'i lan du/ nad 'di la nya ro hi ta'i sha yod na phan zhes zhus pas/ rgyal pos dus bzang po zhig la snga dro khrus byas/ gos gsar pa gyon/ yan lag brgyad pa'i gso sbyong blangs/ dkon mchog la mchod pa rgya chen po phul/ gsol ba drag po btab nas/ bdag shi ma thag tu chu klung ldog byed du nya ro hi tar skye bar gyur cig /ces smon lam btab ste/ khru stong yod pa'i khang bzang steng nas mchongs so// de ma thag chu der brdzus te nya ro hi ta'i skye ba blangs/ de nas mi skad du nga nya ro hi ta yin pas/ nga'i sha longs la zo zhig nad la phan par 'gyur/ zhes smras pas thams cad kyis sha blangs te/ gzhogs gcig gi sha zad tsa na/ gzhogs bsgyur zhing bcad pas gcig zad tsa na gcig gi sha skyes te/ de ltar re mos kyis zos pas nad pa thams cad la phan no// der mi thams cad la nga khyed tsho'i rgyal po pad+ma yin te/ ngas khyod rnams nad las skyob pa'i ched du rang gi srog blos btang nas nya ro hi tar skye ba yin pas/

khyod tshos nga la drin lan du sdig pa spongs la dge ba ci nus sgrubs shig gsungs pas/ de dag gis bka' bzhin du bsgrubs pas/ de nas bzung ste de dag ngan 'gro log par ma lhung ngo*// zhes sogs sems can gyi don du/ bu dang bu mo chung ma/ lus longs spyod dge rtsa dang bcas pa phangs pa med par btang ba'i rnam thar mtha' yas so// drang srong dmod me mi bzad pas// skye bo mang po bsregs par gyur// khyod kyi ye shes me yis ni// skye bo rnams kyi skye rgyu bsregs// zhes pa ste/ phyi pa'i skyabs yul drang srong ser skya la sogs pa'i dmod pa'i me mi bzad pa ste ma rungs pas skye bo mang po bsregs par gyur la/ ston pa mchog khyed kyi bden pa'i gnas lugs mtha' gnyis bral bar rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi me yis ni skye bo rnams kyi 'khor bar skye ba'i rgyu nyon mongs pa bsregs pa ste spangs pa byas zhes so// drang srong dmod pa grub pa las// dka' thub grub par rjes su dpag / mgon khyod thugs rje grub pa las// dka' thub grub par rjes su dpag / ces pa ni/ gzhan gyis mchog tu smra ba'i drang srong rnams kyi dmod pa'i nus mthu grub pa las/ dka' thub grub pa ste dka' thub kyi mthar thug par rjes su dpag pa ste nges par byas la/ lhar bcas 'gro ba'i mgon po khyed kyis ni/ snying rje goms pa mthar phyin pa'i thugs rje chen po grub pa las/ dka' thub grub pa ste mthar son par rjes su dpag ces pa 'di ni bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs pa'i lag rjes/ yul dus thabs shes rnam pa kun nas 'gro ba kun la mtha' gcig tu phan par bzhed pa'i kun tu bzang po'i gzugs sku thob pa la bzhed do// lha chen 'dod pa can gyi mtshan/ drang srong rnams kyi dmod pas lhung*// khyed kyis phung khrol mtha' dag gi /rtsa ba 'dod pa nyid lhung bgyis// zhes pa ni/ lha chen dbang phyug 'dod pa can gyi mtshan ma ste liṅga*/

drang srong khros pa rnams kyi dmod pas sa la lhung bar byas/ de yang sngon drang srong khyo shug mang po yod pa la/ dus shig drang srong shing 'thu ba la song tshe/ dbang phyug gis drang srong gi chung ma bu mo dang bcas pa rnams la chags te 'dod pa spyod pa phyis su drang srong rnams kyis shes nas khros pas dmod pa bor bas dbang phyug gi liṅga sa la lhung*/ de nas drang srong rnams kyis dbang phyug gi mtshan ma yin par shes nas de tsha bar gnas pa la bsil ba'i don du chu gtor nas phyag mchod byed srol de nas da bar gnas pa yin par grag / sangs rgyas bcom ldan khyed kyis/ rang gzhan kun la nyes skyon rgud tshogs kyi phung khrol mtha' dag gi ste ma lus pa 'byung ba'am gzhi yi rtsa ba sems rgyud kyi 'dod pa'i chags pa nyid de 'ba' zhig lhung bar bgyis pa ste spangs par mdzad pa'o// gling las skyes sogs phal cher ni// gzhan gyis gang smras smra bar bgyid// khyod kyis thun mong ma yin chos// rang gis thugs su chud nas ston// zhes pa ni/ sngon drang srong zhig gling bar du nya pa'i bu dang 'dus pa las skyes pa'i drang srong gling las skyes/ mtshan gzhan drang srong rgyas pa zhes bya ba/ mu stegs pa'i bstan bcos ma hā bhā ra ta sh+lo ka 'bum yod pa sogs brtsams pa'i mkhas pa de la sogs pa mu stegs pa'i gtso bor grags pa phal cher ni/ skyon ma lus pa zad cing yon tan ma lus pa 'thob par byed pa'i lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa la myong goms mthar phyin pa lta zhog /nor 'khrul bral ba'i nges rnyed med par ma zad de lta bu'i lam 'bras bzang po la blo kha tsam yang ma phyogs par/ gzhan gyis gang smras pa smra bar bgyid pa'i rjes 'brang lad mo lta bu sgra sbyor zer rgyug tsam du zad la/ thub dbang khyed kyis 'jig rten na dregs pa'i lha klu drang srong gnod sbyin sogs dang thun mong ma yin pa'i chos/

skyon kun zad yon tan kun ldan gyi lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i tshul lugs bla na med pa 'di la rang gis thos bsam sgom gsum gyis thugs su chud nas te myong sgom mthar phyin nas/ gzhan la lan dang*/ grags pa sogs la mi lta bar snying rje chen pos kun nas bslangs te rang dbang du ston pa'o// mu stegs can gyi rig byed tshig /dben pa kho nar smra ba bgyid// khyod kyis bsgrags nas seng ge yi// sgra yis chos dag ston par mdzad// ces pa ni/ mu stegs can gyi bstan bcos rig byed bzhi yi tshig don/ rig byed slob dpon rnams kyis/ bram ze'i rigs yin pa/ cho gas bram ze'i gral du bcug par byas nas gnas dben pa kho nar lkog chos su smra bar bgyid cing*/ ston mchog khyed kyis rigs rus dbyer med cing 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i dbus su bsgrags nas 'jigs med seng ge'i sgra yis chos kyi gnas tshul tshang la ma nor bar yang dag par ston par mdzad do// rnam pa tshos rang gis gang shes gzhan la phyogs ris med par gsungs dgos/ de nang pa'i khyad chos yin// grangs can bha ra dwa dza ni// de nyid mthong yang dpyid ldan la// yongs su chags kyi gtso khyod kyi// slob ma'ang bud med nyid ma chags// zhes pa ni/ sngon tshe lo dpag tu med pa'i dus su byung ba'i grangs can gyi grub mtha'i 'khor 'das kyi rnam gzhag la shes bya'i grangs nyi shu rtsa lngar 'dod/ de'i nang nas spyi gtso bo zhes pa/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin/ gnas lugs mthar thug yin/ des rnam 'gyur ram/ 'bras bu rnams skyed par byed pas bde sdug sna tshogs pa'i 'khor bar 'khor la/ de nyid nyer lnga'i 'jug ldog la sbyangs pa'i mthar/ rnal 'byor pas gzugs sgra sogs byed pa po gtso bo yin par mngon sum du mthong tshe/ spyi gtso bo sems med bem po yin yang*/ skyengs pa'i tshul gyis gzugs sgra sogs rnam 'gyur rnams mi skyed pas 'khor ba las grol ba ni thar pa thob par smra ba'o//

de lta bu'i thar pa la yid brtan med pa ni/ sngon gnyis ldan gyi dus su byung ba'i grangs can gyi ston pa bha ra dwa dza na zhes byas bas/ de nyid nyer lnga'i 'byung tshul dang*/ ldog tshul mngon sum du mthong yang*/ dpyid ldan ma la yongs su chags pa ste/ chags pa rab tu drag po skyes pas thar pa las nyams mod kyi lhar bcas 'gro ba'i gtso bo khyed kyi su la'ang chags pa ma skyes par ma zad/ khyed kyi slob ma nyan thos shā ri'i bu la sogs pa'ang lha mi'i bud med nyid la ma chags ste mi dga'o// 'ug pa pas ni dman pa las// khyad par can la sbyin zhes bstan// mgon po khyod ni thugs rje yis// khyi la'ang sbyin par bya zhes gsungs// zhes pa ni/ sngon drang srong gzegs zan gyis dbang phyug chen po bsgrubs pa'i skabs shig dbang phyug gi liṅga la/ bya 'ug pa babs pa la shes bya tshig gi don drug dris pa la/ drug po re re la mgo bo gug pa lan re byas la de phan mi byed pas/ 'ug pa dbang phyug gi sprul par 'du shes nas 'ug pa la skyabs su brten pas 'ug pa pa zhes grags pa de yis/ gang zag dman pa las khyad par can ste khyad par du 'phags pa'i mchog la sbyin par byed dgos zhes bstan pa ste/ mchog la sbyin na 'bras bu yang mchog 'byung*/ dman pa la sbyin na 'bras bu yang dman zhes gsungs la/ srid pa dang zhi ba'i mgon po khyed ni rang la 'bras bu chen po 'byung ba la mi lta bar gzhan sdug bsngal dang 'bral bar 'dod pa'i thugs rje chen po yis/ gang zag dman pa khyi la'ang sbyin par bya zhes rang gis nyams su bstar ba'i mdzad pa slob ma la rjes su 'doms pa'i sgo nas gsungs pa'o// lus kyi dka' thub bgyis pa yis// mdud pa 'jig par gcer bus 'tshal// khyod ni thugs kyi dka' thub kyis// mdud pa 'jig par bzhed pa lags// zhes lus kyis me lnga bsten pa/ gcer bur rgyu ba/ zas mi za ba dang*/

slong mo'i brtul zhugs skra 'bal ba sogs kyi dka' thub bgyis pa yis ni mdud pa ste nyon mongs pa rnams zad pa'am/ 'jig pa nyid du mu stegs gcer bu pa rnams kyis 'tshal pa ste/ 'tshal zhes pa 'dod ces pa'i don no// de la gcer bu pa zhes bya ba ni/ rtag smra sde bzhi'i nang tshan mu stegs pa zhig ste/ khos lus la gos ma gyon par gcer bur bsdad pa'i dka' thub la gnas pas ming la de ltar grags/ ming gzhan thal ba'i gos can dang*/ phyogs kyi gos can zhes kyang bya/ deng sang rgya gar nang jain zhes zer ba'i chos lugs de yin/ de dag gis las 'bras la ha cang rtsi 'jog chen po byed/ rab byung rnams lta ci khyim pas kyang sha mi za/ lugs snga ma gcer bu kho na 'dug pa yin yang*/ phyis su gos dkar po gcig pu gyon mkhan zhig ste lugs gnyis yod/ 'on kyang khong gnyis gos gyon mi gyon tsam las grub mtha' la khyad par cher med pa yin/ 'dis 'jig rten thams cad sngon gyi las kyis skyes par 'dod pa nang pa dang cha 'dra ba yod/ grub mtha' 'di sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten du ma byon pa'i sngon du byung ba yin/ de la gcer bu pa'i ston pa nyi shu rtsa lnga byung ba las thog ma'i ming la khyu mchog zer/ tha ma'i ming la 'phel ba zer/ 'phel ba dang bdag cag gi ston pa gnyis dus mnyam pa yin/ khong gnyis phan tshun 'brel 'dris kyang yod pa 'dra/ deng sang rgya gar du chos lugs 'di byed mkhan mang po yod/ 'di dka' thub dang sdom pa gnyis su 'dod la/ dka' thub kyis sngon gyi las zad/ sdom pas phyis byung gi las bkag par byas nas thar pa thob par 'dod do// de la grub mtha' 'di cung zad rgyas par bkral na/ bram ze rgyal ba dam pa zhes bya ba'i rjes su 'brangs nas gzhung rgyal byed sogs la tshad mar 'dod cing*/ shes bya thams cad tshig gi don bdun du 'du ba'i gzhung smra ste/ tshig gi don bdun ni/

dka' thub/ sdom pa/ nyon mongs/ bcings pa/ grol ba/ srog yod/ srog med dang bdun no// de la dka' thub kyi don ni gong du bshad pa ltar la/ sdom pa ni/ dge ba bcu yi tshul khrims bsrung ba ste/ 'bu srin srog chags gsad par dwogs nas rkang pa la dril g.yer 'dogs/ ma sbyin pa len du dwogs nas sbyin mkhan med na lung stong gi chu yang mi 'thung*/ rdzun smrar dwogs nas gtam mi smra ba ngag gcad byed/ nam mkha' la yod pa'i 'bu srin phra mo gsad du dwogs nas kha la ras dkar po 'gebs pa sogs las 'bras zhib par bsrung ba'o// nyon mongs ni/ 'dod chags/ zhe sdang*/ gti mug gsum du 'dod/ bcings pa ni/ 'khor bar 'khor ba'o// thar pa ni/ dka' thub kyi stobs kyis las mtha' dag zad pa'i tshe 'jig rten thams cad kyi steng na 'dug pa'i gnas 'jig rten 'dus pa zhes bya ba gdugs dkar po gyen du bslangs pa lta bu zho'am/ ku mu ta ltar dkar ba tshad dpag tshad 'bum phrag zhe lnga yod pa/ srog yod pas dngos po yin zhing*/ 'khor ba las grol ba'i dngos po med pa'ang yin pa der 'gro ba ste/ rgyal ba dam pas/ kha ba rgya spos me tog dang*// ba zho ku mu ta 'dra zhing*// gdugs bstan bzung ba'i dbyibs 'dra ba// thar pa yin pa rgyal bas bshad// ces 'dod do// srog ni/ sems yin te srog dang lus dbang ldan pa 'byung ba bzhi/ rna ba sogs dbang po so so dang ldan pa'i shing yod cing*/ dung nya phyis sogs la lus lce gnyis yod kyi dbang po gzhan med/ de bzhin me khyer grog ma gsum la lus lce sna gsum/ sbrang bu mchu ring sogs la mig dbang ma gtogs gzhan med/ mi rta sogs la dbang po lnga ga yod de 'di rnams srog ldan no// srog dang bdag ni gcig ste/ dper na/ sbrul 'khyil na'ang sbrul yin pa bzhin du skyes bu rnams kyi lus kyi tshad ji lta ba bzhin du yod pa ngo bo rtag la gnas skabs mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin du 'dod do// srog med pa ni/
sgra dri ro 'od nam mkha' grib ma 'ja' gzugs brnyan la sogs par 'dod/ spyir shes bya thams cad yul dus grangs kyi tha dad la rang bzhin gcig par 'dod do//

yang tshig gi don dgur 'dod pa'ang yod de/ de lta na/ srog dang*/ zag pa dang*/ sdom pa dang*/ nges par rga ba dang*/ 'ching ba dang/ las dang*/ sdig pa dang*/ bsod nams dang*/ thar pa dgu'o// de las srog dang sdom pa dang 'ching ba dang thar pa rnams ni gong du bshad pa ltar la/ nges par rga ba ni dka' thub dang don gcig /zag pa ni dge ba dang mi dge ba'i las rnams yin te/ de'i dbang gis 'khor bar zag par byed pa'i phyir zhes 'dod/ las ni phyis myong bar 'gyur ba dang*/ ming dang*/ rus dang*/ tshe'o// sdig pa ni chos min pa'o// bsod nams ni chos su 'dod do// de ltar mu stegs gcer bu pas ni lus kyi dka' spyad kyis sgrib pa dang*/ las zad nas thar pa 'thob par 'dod la/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das khyed ni de ltar mi bzhed de thugs kyi dka' thub bam sems kyi dka' thub kyis nyon mongs pa'i mdud pa mtha' dag 'jig cing spong bar bzhed pa lags/ zhes pa ste tshigs su bcad pa 'dis mu stegs gcer bu pa'i 'dod pa las sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i lam khyad par du 'phags pa'i tshul gyis bstod pa yin no// de ltar ma zad 'dis gdams ngag kyang bstan pa yin te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa thams cad gtso bo sems 'dul ba'i slad du gsungs pa yin/ kun slong bzang po byang chub kyi sems sogs kyis sems 'dul bar ma byas na lus kyi dka' spyad kho nas sgrib pa zad nas thar pa 'thob mi nus/ des na nga tshos rang gi sems rgyud 'dul ba'i thabs la 'bad pa gal che ba yin te/ so sor thar pa'i mdo las/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing*// dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad// rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin// zhes dang*/ bshes springs las/ khyod kyis thugs dul mdzod cig bcom ldan gyis// sems ni chos kyi rtsa ba lags par gsungs// zhes sogs gsungs pa bzhin no//

rtog ge pa dag dngos po rnams// ltos pa med par grub par 'tshal// tshig dbang khyod kyis cung zad kyang*// mi ltos med ces legs par gsungs// zhes/ rtog ge pa la byis pa rtog ge pa dang*/ grub mtha'i rtog ge pa gnyis las 'dir phyi ma ste mu stegs rkang mig pa dang*/ tshad smra rgyang 'phen pa la go dgos shing de dag gis gzugs la sogs pa'i dngos po rnams rgyu dang rkyen la bltos pa med par rang gi ngo bo nyid kyis grub par 'tshal zhes pa'o// phyi ma 'di'i grub mtha' cung zad rgyas par bshad na/ rgyang 'phen pa ni lha phur bu'i rjes su 'brangs nas lta ba'i snying po zhes bya ba dang phur bu'i rgyud drug sogs kyi gzhung la brten nas tshe snga phyi las rgyu 'bras sogs med par 'dod/ skye ba snga ma nas 'dir 'ong ba med de/ skye ba snga ma zhes pa sus kyang ma mthong ba'i phyir/ lus glo bur ba las sems glo bur du grub pa yin te/ mar me glo bur du grub pa las 'od glo bur du grub pa bzhin dang*/ chang la phabs btab pas chang gi nus pa gsar du 'byung ba bzhin no// skye ba 'di nas phyi mar 'gro ba'ang med de/ lus sems rdzas gcig pa lus 'jig pa na blo yang 'jig pa'i phyir/ dper na/ rdo 'jig pa na rdo'i ri mo 'jig pa bzhin no// des na 'di'i gzhal bya la rang mtshan dang*/ tshad ma la mngon sum tshad ma gcig pus khyab par 'dod/ spyi mtshan dang*/ rjes dpag tshad ma khas mi len/ chos thams cad ngo bo nyid las byung ba yang*/ ji skad du/ nyi shar chu bo thur du babs pa dang*// sran zlum tsher ma gzang ring rno ba dang*// rma bya'i mdongs legs la sogs chos rnams kun// sus kyang ma byas ngo bo nyid las byung*// zhes 'byung ngo*// de ltar rgyang 'phen pas 'jig rten thams cad rgyu med las byung bar 'dod la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das tshig la dbang 'byor ba khyod kyis ni dngos po rnams rgyun du rkyen la bltos nas byung ba dang*/

dngos med dngos po la bltos nas btags pa yin pas rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba ste chos cung zad cig kyang rgyu dang rkyen la mi bltos par rang dbang tshugs thub kyis grub pa med ces legs par gsungs/ zhes pa ste tshigs su bcad pa 'dis ni mu stegs rgyang 'phen pa'i grub mtha' las sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i lam rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba khyad par du 'phags pa'i tshul gyis bstod pa ste/ mu stegs pa'i ston pa rnams kyis ni lam dang grub mtha' gang smras pa thams cad rten 'brel dang 'gal bar kho nar smra la/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis ni chos thams cad rten 'brel dang mi 'gal ba kho nar smra ba'i dbang gis smra ba thams cad kyi dam pa yin te/ dbu ma rtsa shes kyi mchod brjod du/ gang gis rten cing 'brel ba 'byung*// 'gag pa med pa skye med pa// chad pa med pa rtag med pa// 'ong ba med pa 'gro med pa// tha dad don min don gcig min// spros pa nyer zhi zhi bstan pa// rdzogs pa sangs rgyas smra rnams kyi// dam pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs pa bzhin no// 'dis gdams ngag kyang bstan pa yin te/ chos thams cad rgyu rten 'brel las byung ba'i dbang gis las 'bras kyang bslu ba med pa yin/ rgyu sdig pa bsags pa las 'bras bu sdug bsngal 'byung ba dang*/ rgyu dge ba bsgrubs pa las 'bras bu bde ba 'byung ba ni gnas yin pa dang*/ rgyu sdig pa bsags pa las 'bras bu bde ba 'byung ba dang*/ rgyu dge ba bsags pa las 'bras bu sdug bsngal 'byung ba sogs ni gnas min pas/ dge sdig blang dor phra zhib nas byed dgos par bstan pa yin no// ne tsos nyi ma brtol nas ni// thar pa mchis par bshad ces grag / khyod ni mya ngan 'das brnyes la// gang du yang ni gshegs ma mchis// zhes/ sngon mi thi la'i rgyal po skyed pa po zhes bya ba mu stegs pa rnams kyis skyon gyis ma gos pa'i rgyal po zhes su 'dod pa de nyid kyi slob mar gyur pa drang srong rgyas pa'i bu ne tso zhes bya ba lam bsgoms pas grub pa thob nas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor brtol nas ni nang du son te thar pa mchis pa'am song bar lung las bshad ces mu stegs pa rnams la grag ces pa ste grag gi yid ma rang ba'i tshig yin no// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das khyod ni mya ngan las 'das pa'i go 'phang mchog brnyes pa la phyogs ga shed du 'gro ba lta bu yul gang du yang ni gshegs pa ma mchis/

zhes tshigs su bcad pa 'dis thar pa 'gro bar smra ba'i mu stegs pa'i grub thob ne tso'i lo rgyus dpyad mi bzod pa las sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis bdud rtsi'i go 'phang mngon du mdzad pa khyad par du 'phags pa'i tshul gyi sgo nas bstod pa'o// thar pa rgyud gzhan bskyed pa dang*/ ne tsos lam gzhan song bar gyur// khyod nyid lam gang nas gshegs pa/ de nyid nas ni slob ma'ang mchis// zhes/ rgyal po skyed pa po la nyi ma'i lam nas thar par 'gro ba dang zla ba'i lam nas thar par 'gro ba'i man ngag gnyis yod pa las/ rgyal po rang nyid thar pa de nyid rgyud gzhan te zla ba'i lam nas thar par 'gro bas bskyed pa dang*/ de nyid kyi slob ma ne tso la lam de ma bstan pas lam de las gzhan te nyi ma'i lam nas thar par song bar gyur ces bla ma dang slob ma tha dad song bar bshad la/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das khyed ni rang nyid bde nas bde ba'i lam gang nas gshegs pa de nyid nas ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi slob ma'ang lam de nas mchi/ zhes tshigs su bcad pa 'dis ni lam tha dad du bshad pa'i mu stegs pa'i lam las zhi sgo gnyis su med pa'i lam sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa de nyid khyad par du 'phags pa'i tshul brjod pas bstod pa'o// khyab 'jug dag gis bud med ni// stong phrag drug cu yongs bzung gyur// ston pa 'jig rten 'das khyod la// bdag gi med cing yongs 'dzin med// ces/ khyab 'jug gam ming gzhan kriṣ+ṇa/ bod skad du nag por grags pa de dag gis ni 'dod chags kyi dbang gis bud med kyi tshogs ni stong phrag drug cu yongs su bzung ba'am bdag tu 'dzin par gyur pa'i lo rgyus mu stegs pa'i gzhung las byung la/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i 'gro ba yongs la thar pa bla na med pa'i lam ston pa po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten las 'das pa khyed nyid la ni grags 'dzin ma la sogs pa'i btsun mo'i tshogs rnams bdag gyir byas pa med cing kun tu yongs su 'dzin pa'ang med de de dag spangs so// zhes tshigs su bcad pa 'dis ni mu stegs pa rnams la ston pa mchog dang lha'i mchog tu grags pa khyab 'jug gam kriṣ+ṇa'am nag po ni 'dod chags kyi skyon dang ma bral la/

sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ni 'dod chags kyi sa bon bag chags dang bcas pa spangs pa'i yon tan mchog gi khyad par du 'phags pa brjod pas bstod pa'o// kā shī mdzes dga' mo la ni// rgyas pa yongs chags rnam par gyur// khyod khab bzhugs na'ang phung khrol ba'i// gdon gyis dbang po rmongs ma 'gyur// ces pa ni/ bhā ra ta'i 'thab mo 'das nas lo yun ring po ma lon pa na/ rgyas pa nye dus phongs pa dang*/ sdug bsngal gyis sems zhum pa dang*/ yongs su 'khyams shing*/ wā rā ṇa sīr song ba dang*/ srang bar na kā shī mdzes dga' mo zhes bya ba'i smad 'tshong ma'i gtso mo zhig gi sgo dang nye ba na skye ba'i tshogs chen po mthong ba dang drang srong rgyas pa zhes pa'i yid kyis de'i thad du song ste dris pa/ 'di su zhig gi khyim yin zhes dris nas/ de'i gzugs la sogs pa'i yon tan thos pas sems phyogs te 'dug go /de nas mngag gzhug pa'i skye bo zhig gis kā shī mdzes dga' mo la smras pa/ drang srong zhig sgo na sdod cing 'dug go /de yang dmod pas 'jigs skrag nas bsnyen bkur sngon du 'gro bas bdag nyid kyis mdun bsus te/ nang du bcug nas dben par stan la 'dug tu bcug ste/ rang nyid kyis rkang pa bkrus so// rgyas pas bgad pa dang*/ des de mtshan mar bzung nas glags byed par shes te rab tu dga' bas khyed rgyu med par 'dzum mam zhes smras pa dang*/ des smras pa/ khyod ni sgyu rtsal thams cad la mkhas par thos na lag pa dang rkang pa mnye ba mi shes sam/ des smras pa/ gal te khyod 'di la dgyes par gyur na lag pa rkyongs shig dang bstan par bya'o// des kyang de la lag pa byin no// de nas des ji ltar na 'dod pa'i skye bo khyad par can du ma dang reg par gyur kyang de lta bu'i reg pa sngon chad nyams su myong bar ma gyur pa dag tshor bar byas so// de yang de dang lhan cig tu dus shin tu yun ring mor mngon par dga' ba byas so// de ltar yongs su chags shing 'dod pa'i 'dod chags skyes par 'gyur to// gang la chags she na kā shī mdzes dga' mo la ste smad 'tshong ma'i gtso mo la'o// rnam par 'gyur zhes bya ba ni dus shin tu yin ring mor yang 'dod par rjes su myong bas rnam par 'gyur ba nyid du gyur pa'o// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das khyed ni khab tu bzhugs nas rgyal srid skyong ba'i tshe na'ang nyes pa ste phung khrol ba'i gdon gyis dbang po rmongs par ma gyur/

ces tshigs su bcad pa 'dis ni mu stegs pa'i thub pa chen po drang srong rgyas pa 'dod chags kyi skyon dang ma bral ba las/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'dod chags kyi skyon gyis ma gos pa khyad par du 'phags pa brjod pas bstod pa'o// rgyas pa 'dod gdung g.yen spyo bas// bud med kyi ni rdog pas bsnun// khyod ni khyim par bzhugs na yang// phyir zhing 'khrug par 'gyur ba med// ces/ drang srong rgyas pa ni 'dod pas gdung zhing gzir ba yin pas na gdung ste/ 'dod pa'i 'dod chags kyis gtses zhes bya ba'i don no// g.yen spyo bas zhes bya ba ni brtan pa dang bral zhing sems g.yo ba nyid kyis ngo tsha med par gyur pa'o// bud med kyi ni rdog pas bsnun zhes bya ba ni/ bud med kyi rdog pa dag ste/ des rkang pa gnyis kyis bsnun zhing brdeg ces bya ba'i don no// de yang 'di ltar drang srong rgyas pa kā shī mdzes dga' mo dang lhan cig bag phebs par 'dod pa'i bde ba rjes su myong zhing 'dug pa na dus 'ga' zhig gi tshe grong khyer wā rā ṇa sīr rgyal po tshangs pas byin la/ phas kyi rgol bas 'jigs pa nye bar gyur nas gang gi phyir gzhon nu rnams kyang nyin gcig la 'obs khru bcu bcu rkor bcug pa'i lung bsgo ba na gzhan dag lta smos kyang ci dgos/ kā shī mdzes mo la'ang lung bsgo ba dang*/ des gla rngan chen pos gla mi'i skyes bu btsal kyang ma rnyed nas sems pa zhum par gyur to// rgyas pas smras pa/ ci'i phyir khyed mi dga' bar ma byed tog tse dang skon pa byin cig ngas 'obs brko bar bya'o zhes smras nas/ ji tsam na song ste brkos pa dang 'obs ma rdzogs par nyi ma nub pa la mngon du phyogs par gyur to// de nas rgyas pa dgongs ka'i dus la babs so// rkos nas ma log par de nyid du gnas par gyur to// rgyas pas nyi ma nub tu ma bcug par bzung bas na/

chu tshod la sogs pas mtshan mas nyi ma rdzogs par gyur cing*/ mtshan mo'i dus la babs par shes nas rgyal po dang blon po grong khyer ba dang bcas sems rnam par g.yengs pa dang*/ ji tsam na bram ze gzhan zhig gis 'obs brko ba la g.yengs pa'i sems kyis rgyas pa mthong ba dang yun ring mo zhig na ngo shes par gyur to// de nas de'i rgyu mtshan de las thos pa dang*/ nyi ma mi nub par rgyas pa'i mthu yin par shes nas rgyal po dang blon po grong khyer gyi skye bo dang bcas pa de'i thad du song ste/ rkang pa gnyis la gtugs nas bzod par gsol ba dang*/ de gdong gzhan du blta zhing brko ba nyid kyis gnas so// de yang dmod pa'i 'jigs pas skrag pa dang*/ 'di ni kā shī mdzes dga' mo'i skal ba brko bar shes nas de la 'phrin du bskur ba/ thub pa khyad par can 'di khyod kyi skal pa'i 'obs brkor bcug pa las slongs shig ces byas pa dang*/ des bu mo mngag gzhug ma zhig lan gsum du btang yang de langs su ma 'dod de/ de nas de rang nyid bzhon pa la zhon te/ 'ongs nas bzhon pa las bab ste/ rkang gdub dang bcas pa'i rkang pas mgo bor bsnun te/ gang gi phyir nga ni skyo bar 'gyur nas ngas lan gsum gyi bar du 'phrin bskur na ci'i phyir ldang bar mi byed/ rgyas pa yid dga' bar gyur pa dang smras pa/ gang gi phyir 'di ltar brtse bas shin tu rjes su bzung ba yin no zhes smras nas langs par gyur to// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das khyod ni btsun mo'i tshogs rnams dang lhan cig tu khyim par bzhag pa'i tshe na'ang phyir zhing 'dod pa'i 'dod chags kyis thugs 'khrug par 'gyur ba med ces tshigs su bcas pa 'dis ni mu stegs pa'i thub pa drang srong rgyas pa kā shī mdzes dga' mo dang lhan cig tu gnas pa'i tshe 'dod pa'i 'dod chags kyi sems gzhan dbang du gyur pa la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ni btsun mo'i tshogs bcas khyim par bzhugs pa'i dus su yang 'dod pa'i skyon gyis ma gos pas khyad par 'phags pa brjod pa'i sgo nas bstod pa'o//

dga' byed chung ma'i don gyi phyir// rgya 'tsho'i pha rol son ces grag / khyod kyis bud med stong phrag ni// brgyad cu spangs nas nags su gshegs// zhes/ rgyal po shing rta bcu pa'i bu khyab 'jug gi 'jug pa bcu pa'i nang tshan dga' byed rā ma ṇa ni chung ma si tā'am rol rnyed ma'i don gyi phyir rgya mtsho'i pha rol te siṅga la ru son ces grag go / 'di'i lo rgyus ni/ siṅga la'i rgyal po srin po sgra sgrogs kyi bu rā wa ṇa des dbang phyug chen po yun ring du bsgrubs kyang ma grub pas rang nyid la mgo bcu yod pa re re nas bcad pa sbyin sreg tu phul te/ mgrin pa'i lhag ma tsam re lus par byas pas laṅgā mgrin bcur grags/ de'i bya dka' ba'i snying stobs chen po de la dbang phyug chen po mgu nas lha mo la u ma khyod song la dngos grub byin cig ces bsgo ba ltar de de'i gam du song nas ci 'dod sbyin par khas blangs pa la/ bdag bud med las dngos grub mi 'dod ces smras pa la u ma khros nas ma 'ongs pa na khyod kyi rgyal srid bud med kyis 'joms par gyur cig ces brjod nas phyir song ngo*// slar yang lha chen pos rang gi bu bar pa spre'u'i gdong can mngags pas dngos grub ci 'dod dris pa la/ nga spre'u las dngos grub len par mi 'dod zer/ de yang khros nas ma 'ongs pa na khyod kyi rgyal srid spre'us brlag par gyur cig ces brjod nas song ngo*// de nas dbang phyug chen po rang nyid byon nas de yi mgrin pa rnams slar yang mgo bo dang ldan par byin gyis brlabs nas dbus kyi rta mgo ma bcad par 'chi ba med pa dang sa gsum las rnam par rgyal ba chen po'i dngos grub byin pas 'jig rten gsum bran du 'khol bar gyur to// de 'joms par byed pa khyab 'jug gi 'jug pa bcu yi nang tshan rā ma gnyis las shing rta bcu pa'i bu dga' byed rā ma ṇa zhes bya ba de ni/

ra bhu zhes pa rigs kyi ming yin pas 'di la ra ghu'i bu yang zer ro// de'i yab kyis rā ma ṇa la smras pa/ nga sngon lha dang lha min g.yul 'gyed pa'i sar phyin te lha'i phyogs bzung nas lha min dang 'thab pas lha ma yin gyi mtshon cha mang po nga'i lus la zug pa'i rma yod pa de/ grong khyer 'thab pa med pa zhes bya bar nga'i chung ma kai ke yīs gsos pa'i bya dga' la kai ke yī'i bu khyod kyi nu bo bha ra ta la rgyal srid sbyin rgyu yin pas/ rā ma ṇa khyod chung ma si tā dang bcas pa lo bcu gnyis nags su song zhig ces bka' stsal pa na/ dang du blangs nas chung ma dang bcas pa nags su song ngo*// 'di'i chung ma si tā zhes pa de ni/ srin yul du bu mo mtshar sdug can zhig skyes pa de nyid yul der bzhag na laṅkā'i grong brlag pa'i mtshan ma shar bas bu mo de zangs sgrom du bcug nas chu la bskyur ba/ 'dzam bu'i gling du zhing la chu drangs pa'i rmos rol gyi nang du khyer byung ba zhing pa rnams kyis sgrom de kha phye nas bltas pas bu mo khyad 'phags shig 'dug pa mi thi la'i rgyal po skyed pa po la phul/ rang gi bu mo ltar bskyangs pas skyed pa po'i bu mor grags pa de nyid 'dzam bu'i gling gi rgyal po shing rta bcu pa'i sras rgyal po rā ma ṇa la btsun mor phul to// de'i ming zhing pa rnams kyis rol nang nas rnyed pas rol rnyed ma'am si tā zhes par grags so// rā ma ṇa si tā dang bcas pa nags su rtse dga' la rol zhing gnas pa las/ lan gcig gi tshe srin rgyal sgra sgrogs kyi bu des 'dzam gling 'di na bu mo su mdzes brtags pa las/ si tā kho na mdzes pa mthong nas de 'phrog pa'i phyir srin mo slu byed ma zhes pa chen po la 'os pa'i pags pa can gyi ri dwags shig tu sprul pa de rā ma ṇas gzung bar 'dod nas/ si tā la khyod nga ma slebs bar du 'od kyi ra bas bskor ba 'di las 'das nas ma 'gro zhig

/gal te song na tshe'i dus byed par gyur cig ces dmod bor nas 'od kyi rwa bas bskor nas bzhag go /rang nyid ri dwags de'i rjes snyegs bzhin rgya mtsho'i mthar thug 'ded du phyin pa'i shul du srin rgyal rā wa ṇa bram ze'i gzugs su sprul nas si tā blang bar brtsams pa na/ rgyal po rā ma ṇa bden tshig grub pa'i bka' las 'da' bar ma nus tshe srin pos rdzu 'phrul gyis si tā 'od kyi rwa ba dang bcas pa'i sa gzhi'i khyon te khyer nas srin yul du song bar gyur to// rgyal bu rā ma ṇas ri dwags de ji tsam bdas kyang ma zin pas mig bsgyur ba yin par go nas slar rang gnas su log pa na si tā sa gzhi dang bcas pa 'bod sgrogs kyis khyer bar rig nas rjes brtsad de phyin pa dang*/ chu dron mo kha dog kham skya dri nga zhing rlang pa 'tshub pa gcig dang phrad/ de ga nas 'bab pa ltar phyin pas lung pa de'i phu na spre'u'i rgyal po bā li dang mgrin bzang zhes bya ba gnyis dmag gi tshogs dang bcas te/ rgyal srid la ma 'chams par g.yul 'gyed pa'i ngal ba las byung ba'i rngul gyis rnyog pa'i chu yin par 'dug /der phyin pas sprel rgyal mgrin bzang gis nged rnams rgyal srid kyi don du 'thab pa yin/ da nyi ma gsum nas kho rang rgyal bar 'gyur bas khyed nged kyi grogs bya bar rigs zer ba la/ dga' byed de ni mda' 'phangs tshad phogs pa dang*/ phog tshad 'chi ba dang*/ shi tshad lhar skye ba'i dngos grub grub pa yin pas/ des mda' 'phangs te sprel rgyal bā li gsod par khas blangs so// 'on kyang de nyi ma dang por spre'u'i dmag 'thab pa'i ltad mor g.yengs bas lus/ gnyis par de gnyis mi 'khrul ba'i rtags su mgrin bzang gis dpral ba la me long btags te 'thab pa na dga' byed kyi mda' 'phangs pas bā li bsad nas mgrin bzang gis rgyal srid thob par byas so// de nas mgrin bzang des dga' byed ci 'dod sgrub par khas blangs pa la/

de ltar na kho bo'i chung ma si tā srin pos khyer ba longs shig ces bya ba las/ mgrin bzang na re/ bdag la blon po khyad par can ha nu man+tha zhes yod pa de dang gros bya bar 'o skol thabs cig gshegs zhes zer ba ltar der phyin pas/ ri lung thams cad spre'us gang ba'i khrod na/ tshul ston phyogs ma gtogs dbang phyug chen po'i bu bar pa yin par grags pa spre'u mig gsum pa zhig 'dug pa la/ mgrin bzang gis sngar gyi lo rgyus bsnyad de/ rgyal po 'di drin lan bsab phyir si tā 'gugs thabs ci yod ces byas pa na/ des yud tsam bsams nas don de bsgrub pa'i phyir dang po srin po'i gnas yul brtags pa'i ched du mchongs pa gcig byas pas ha cang thal nas rlung lha'i rgyal khams su bslebs/ de nas phyir mchongs gcig byas pas laṅka pu rir son te bltas pas/ si tā sa gzhi dang bcas pa bza' shing gi rwa ba na btson du 'dug pa mthong*/ de'i rgyu mtshan gzhan dag la dris pas 'di bdag cag gi rgyal po la ma dad pas btson du byas zer/ de nas si tā'i drung du song nas bdag rgyal po rā ma nas btang ba yin/ khyod kyang nga mnyam du 'gro byas pas de yid ma ches pa la lag rtags su rgyal po'i sor gdub bstan/ der si tās bdag bros ci la thub/ rgyal po rang la mthu yod na ston la blang bar rigs so zhes 'phrin bskur ba khyer nas mchongs gcig gis rā ma ṇa'i mdun sar phyin/ rgyu mtshan rnams rgyal po la gsol bas rgyal pos de ma thag tu spre'u'i dmag chen po bsdus nas rgya mtsho chen po'i 'gram du song ste/ drang srong chen po grog mkhar pa la rgya mtsho na srog chags kyi rigs ci 'dra yod ces dris pas/ dpag tshad brgya yi khyon yod pas ti mi zhes pa chu srin nya mid dang*/ de nyid kyang med par byed nus pa dang*/ de yang mid nus pa sogs gdug pa'i sems can du ma yod par thos/ de nas rgya mtsho la sprel dmag sbrel nas zam byas par brten nas dga' byed srin yul du brtol/

de nas rā ma ṇas srin rgyal gsod par brtsams pa na/ de'i pho brang rin po che sna tshogs pa'i khams las grub pa'i gzhal med khang shin tu dwangs pa'i rtsig ngos su srin rgyal mgo bcu de'i gzugs brnyan brgya phrag tu shar ba srin rgyal dngos dang shin tu 'dra ches pa'i dbang gis so sor ma phyed pa'i tshe na/ spre'u mo an+dza na'i bu ha nu man+thas blos zhib mor brtags pas srin rgyal dngos kyi gzugs gang yin pa shes pa de la dga' byed kyi mde'u ste kha can gyi mda' 'phangs pas dbus kyi rta mgo bcad de srin po bsad/ der ma zad gzhan yang srin po bye ba dpag med bsad/ de nas ha nu man+thas bza' shing rwa bar phyin nas 'bras bu can gyi ljon shing mang po rtse sa la btsugs te bzhag pas srin po lhag ma rnams kyis mtha' bskor te ha nu man+tha gsod par brtsams pa na/ des de rnams las thar bar slar yang g.yo sgyu'i rig pa ston phyir khong rnams la zin du bcug ste/ khyed kyi phyogs 'di na khrims yod dam med/ med na nga rang gi khrims lugs bzhin sod zer/ khyed rang gi khrims lugs gang 'dra yin dris pas/ bdag gi ma yi khrims lugs su gsod na bang mdzod du bcug ste zas bzar rung tshad byin dang*/ des mgrin pa 'gags nas bdag 'chi'o// pha'i khrims lugs su gsod na til mar gyis sbags pa'i ras kyis mjug mar dkris la me spor zhig zer bas/ pha'i lugs su gsod par gros mthun par gyur/ der spre'u 'chi ba khyed rnams kyis mthong na ltas ngan yin pas/ rang rang gi khyim du yib zer ba ltar byas pas laṅkā pu ri'i grong khyer sum brtsegs la phyi'i lcags ri dang bcas pa mjug ma'i mes skad cig la bsregs par byas so// de nas dga' byed si tā thob nas rgya mtsho chen po gzhu mchog gis dkrugs shing gru'i nang nas bros pas thar pa dang srin po 'gas rā wa ṇa de'i bu kum+bu kar+ṇa zhes pa'i drang srong bsam gtan pa de'i rna bar khro chu blugs nas ting nge 'dzin las sad par byas te rā wa ṇa bsad pa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus rnams smras pas/

de'i sna sgo'i rlung brngubs pa tsam gyis dga' byed dang ha nu man+tha gnyis ma gtogs si tā dang*/ sprel dmag thams cad keng rus su song*/ de tsam gyis tshims nas slar ting nge 'dzin la zhugs so// der dga' byed kyi ri bo gangs can du shi sos kyi sman yod pa ha nu man+tha len du btang bas sman nor nas slar yang len du btang bas ri bo gangs can nyid khyer te byung ba las dga' byed kyis sman blangs nas/ sman des keng rus su song ba thams cad sngar bzhin gsos nas ri bo gangs can 'di sngar gyi rang gnas su skyol cig byas pas/ des tshegs che zer nas 'phangs pas ri de sngar yod pa'i shul du song yang cung zad yor zhes grags/ de nas rgyal po dga' byed si tā dang bcas me tog can zhes bya ba'i gzhal yas khang du zhugs te gnas pa la bu bha ra ta sogs kyis mchod cing gsol ba btab pa la brten nas grong khyer 'thab pa med par gshegs nas srid pa'i bde ba la rol par gyur to zhes gtam rgyud du grags so// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das khyed kyis ni sa 'tsho ma la sogs bud med stong phrag dang ni brgyad cu yod pa rnams yongs su spangs nas nags kyi gnas su bla na med pa'i byang chub bsgrubs pa'i phyir du gshegs/ zhes tshigs su bcad pa 'dis ni mu stegs pa'i ston pa khyab 'jug gi 'jug pa bcu'i nang tshan dga' byed rā ma ṇa ni chung ma rol rnyed ma la chags pa'i skyon dang ldan pa dang*/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis btsun mo'i tshogs yongs su spangs te chags pa'i skyon thams cad dang bral ba'i khyad par 'phags pa'i tshul brjod de bstod pa'o// rna can 'thab dka' la sogs la// khyab 'jug gis ni gnod pa brtsams// sems can rnams la phan bzhed pa// khyod kyis srog kyang btang bar mdzad// ces/ kar+ṇa 'am rna can dang*/ 'thab dka' la sogs pa'i sgra ngan dpung tshogs bcu gnyis la kriṣ+ṇa 'am khyab 'jug gis ni gnod pa brtsams nas skya bseng gi bu lnga dang 'thab tu bcug ste/

zhag bco brgyad kyi bar du 'khrug pas sems can bye ba phyed dang drug tsam bsad par grags la/ sems can mtha' yas pa rnams la gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan pa ma lus pa sgrub par bzhed pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das khyed kyis ni sems can gyi don du sku srog kyang btang bar mdzad/ ces tshigs su bcad pa 'dis ni kriṣ+ṇa zhe sdang dang g.yo sgyu ldan la sems can la 'tshe ba dang*/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ni zhe sdang yongs su spangs nas dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen pos sems can thams cad la phan par mdzad pa'i sgo nas khyad par 'phags pas bstod pa'o// khyab 'jug gis ni sgyu byas nas// gom gsum gyis phrogs gang yin pa'i// sa de nges par thar bzhed pa// khyod kyis rtswa bzhin btang bar gyur// ces pa/ sngon stobs ldan zhes bya ba'i lha ma yin gyi dbang po zhig byung ba dang*/ des rang gi pha rol gnon pas khams gsum ma lus pa rnam par gnon pa brgya byin la sogs pas ma bzod nas de gzhom pa'i phyir gsol ba btab pa na khyab 'jug gis bsams pa/ ngas 'di dang lhan cig tu g.yul sprod par mi nus te/ shin tu skyes bu rtsol ba phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa yin pa'i phyir ro// de bas na nges par sgyu thabs kyis bslu bar bya'o snyam du bsams nas bdag nyid bram ze mi'u thung gi gzugs su sprul nas slong mo'i bdag nyid can du byas te song nas/ rgyal po stobs ldan rta'i mchod sbyin byed pa'i brtul zhugs la gnas pa'i tshe/ su zhig gang zhig ci zhig 'dod// gang la ci zhig sbyin par bya// zhes zer ba la brtson pa de'i thad du byon nas pha dang ma'i don du me la mchod sbyin byed pas de'i don du sa phyogs gom pa gang nyid kyi tshad slong ngo*// zhes smras pa dang*/ des smras pa/ 'di tsam zhig gis khyod la dgos pa ci zhig rdzogs par gyur to// gzhan du na glang po dang rta dang shing rta dang*/

gser la sogs pa'i dngos po slongs shig dang*/ de ngas dgag pa med pa dang*/ khyad par dang bcas pa sbyin par bya'o// zhes smras kyang 'dod par ma gyur te/ de nas des smras pa/ gal te de ltar 'dod na re zhig gom pa gsum yang khyer cig ces smras pa dang khyab 'jug gis gom pa gnyis kyis 'jig rten gsum gyi bar du rkang pa gcig brkyangs nas gom pa gsum pa'i gnas ma rnyed par dris pa na des nga'i mgo la zhog cig ces smras pas mgo bo rdog pas bsnun nas sa 'og tu bcings par gyur to// stobs ldan deng sang yang sa 'og na gnas par grags so// des na sngon gyi snyan ngag mkhan dag gis/ sbyin bdag stobs ldan khyab 'jug slong ba po// rta yi mchod sbyin dus su sa chen sbyin// 'bras bu bcings pa nyid ni thob par gyur// 'chol bar byed pa'i las 'di su zhig smon// zhes smras pa lta bu'o// de ltar khyab 'jug gis ni lha ma yin gyi dbang po stobs ldan g.yo sgyu byas nas bslus te gom pa gsum gyis phrogs pa'i sa yi dkyil 'khor gang yin pa'i sa de ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nges par thar bar bzhed pa khyed nyid kyis ni yongs su ma bzung ba rtswa bzhin du btang bar gyur/ ces tshigs su bcad pa 'dis ni khyab 'jug g.yo sgyu'i skyon dang ma bral la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ni g.yo sgyu med cing chags pa med pa'i sgo nas khyad par du 'phags zhes bstod pa'o//

'di gdams ngag kyang yin te/ g.yo sgyu gzhan gyi mgo skor byed pa ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs ma yin pas/ rang cag rnams kyis g.yo sgyu spangs nas sgo gsum drang por bsrang dgos zhes 'doms pa'ang yin no// dga' byed srog gcod byed pa'i mdas// 'jig rten rgyal rigs med byas nas// grags pa thob pa gang yin de// khyed kyi bstan la grags pa min// ces pa ni/ sngon drang srong dza ma dag+ni zhes bya ba/ dka' thub kyis nags na gnas pa de'i chung ma brtul zhugs can ma zhes bya ba de ni ngang tshul bzang po can yin pas/ me tog 'thur song tshe shing rnams rang nyid la 'dud par byed pa zhig yod pa de'i bu dgra sta rā ma ṇa zhes pa dpa' zhing dka' thub dang ldan pa yod de/ der rgyal po srid sgrub brtson zhes bya ba lag pa stong yod pa zhes su grags pa zhig gnas der phyin pa na drang srong de'i 'dod 'jo'i ba zhig yod pa ser ba'i sgras skrag pa la/ rgyal po srid sgrub brtson gyis drang srong mis byin la 'di ci la skrag pa yin zhes dris pa dang*/ drang srong de pha rol 'thab pa la dga' bas/ 'di ni drang srong dza ma dag+ni'i bu rā ma ṇa zhes pa'i 'phong slob pa'i gzhu rgyud brdab pa la skrag go /bu 'di ni dpa' zhing 'phong gi gnas la mkhas pa sogs ngan spong gi rigs dga' byed de'i bsngags pa brjod pas/ rgyal po des de la phrag dog skyes te/ 'thab par 'dod pa de'i gnas su song bas chung ma brtul ldan ma rgyal po la yid chags pa dang*/ de phan chad de la shing rnams 'dud par mi byed par gyur to// de nas rgyal pos 'dod 'jo'i be'u phrogs/ dga' byed bsam gtan gnas pa'i steng du sbrul gyi ro zhig bskyur nas song ngo*// brtul zhugs ldan ma'i gnas tshul de drang srong dza ma dag+ni yis bsam gtan stobs kyis shes nas khros te/ dga' byed la 'di'i mgo bo chod ces smras ma thag tu pha'i bka' bzhin de'i mgo bo bcad do// pha mgu nas khye'u la mchog slongs shig byas pa dang/

bdag gi ma 'tsho bar gyur cig ces smras pas de 'tsho bar gyur to// de nas be'u phrogs pa'i 'khon gyi rgyu des dga' byed kyis bdag gis 'jig rten na rgyal rigs gcig kyang med par bya'o// zhes dam bcas nas/ 'phong legs par bslabs/ 'khor bsdus te nam zhig na rgyal po srid grub dang g.yul 'gyed pas de la lag pa stong yod pa dgra stas bcad de thang la lhung bar byas/ de nas bzung ste de yi mdas 'jig rten na rgyal rigs mtha' dag lan nyer gcig gi bar du pham par byas te kuruk+ṣe tra zhes pa'i 'obs dpag tshad 'ga' rgyal rigs kyi khrag gis bkang nas pha mes kyi mchod sbyin byas pas sa chen po mtha' dag rang dbang du byas so zhes khyab 'jug gi 'jug pa bcu'i nang tshan rā ma gnyis las dgra sta rā ma ṇa'i lo rgyus so// khyab 'jug mi ru sprul pa dgra sta rā ma ṇa yis rgyal po srid sgrub sogs kyi srog gcod par byed pa'i mdas 'jig rten na gnas pa'i rgyal rigs thams cad lan nyer gcig gi bar du cham la phab cing med par byas nas de'i rgyus sa chen po mtha' dag la rang dbang du byas so zhes grags pa thob pa gang yin pa de sangs rgyas bcom ldan khyed kyi bstan pa la shin tu smad par bya ba'i gnas yin gyi snyan par grags pa ni min no// zhes tshigs su bcad pa 'dis ni khyab 'jug gi sprul pa dgra sta rā ma ṇa zhe sdang gi skyon ma spangs shing sems can la gnod 'tshe bgyid la/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la zhe sdang spangs shing sems can la mi 'tshe bar bstan pas khyad par du 'phags pa'i sgo nas bstod pa'o// sgra ngan dang ni skya bseng dag /gang gi phyir ni g.yul bkye ba'i// dpal de khyod kyis 'khri shing ni// gdug pa bzhin du spangs nas gshegs// zhes/ bstan dka' la sogs pa'i sgra ngan dpung tshogs bcu gnyis kyi phyogs dang ni g.yul ngor brtan pa dang*/

'jigs sde dang*/ srid sgrub dang*/ lhar bcas/ rigs med de skya bseng gi bu lnga yi phyogs su gyur pa dag /rgyal srid thob pa gang gi phyir ni 'dzam bu'i gling du rtsod ldan gyi dus kyi thog mar g.yul ngo bkye bar byas pa'i rgyal srid kyi dpal de lta bu ni thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das khyed kyis dug sbrul gyi yongs su 'khyud pa'i 'khri shing dag gi gdug pa can yin pa bzhin du shes shing mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin yongs su spangs nas zhi ba bla na med pa'i go 'phang mchog der bde blag tu gshegs/ zhes tshigs su bcad pa 'dis ni mu stegs pa rnams kyis ming nas brjod pas kyang bsod nams gsog par 'dod pa'i skya bseng gi bu lnga rgyal srid la chags nas sems can la gnod 'tshe byas pa dang*/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis ni rgyal srid yongs su spangs pa'i khyad par du 'phags pa'i sgo nas bstod pa'o// khyod kyi bstan pa rnyed pa na// thang shing nags na lha chen po// rnal 'byor dbang phyug spyod pa po// de ni mi shes spyod par bas// zhes bya ba ni/ thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das khyed kyi bstan pa la dad pas zhugs nas yid ches kyi nges pa cung zad rnyed pa na/ thang shing gi nags tshal na dben par gnas pa'i lha dbang phyug chen po zhes bya ba rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tu grags pa dka' thub spyod pa po gang yin pa de ni mi shes pa'i skye bo phan pa'i spyod pa'ang tshul can yan par bas so// zhes pa ste bas zhes pa zad ces pa'i don no// dbang po bshol med byi bo zhes// bram ze da dung bar du sgrogs// khyod kyis 'bras bu mchog brnyes pa'i// grags pa brgya byin sgrogs par gyur// ces bya ba ni/ sngon lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis/ drang srong go'u ta ma'i chung ma bshol med ma la log par spyod pas/ 'jig rten na gzhan gyi chung ma la spyad na byi bo dang*/

skyes pa gzhan dang log par zhugs pa'i bud med la byi mo dang*/ de'i bu dang bu mo byi phrug ces grags pa ltar brgya byin la yang de nas bzung byi bo zhes grags pa'i gtam de bram ze rnams kyi da dung gi bar du'am da lta'i bar du khyad chos su sgrogs par byed do// 'dis ni grags pa'i rjes su 'brang ba'i skye bo rmongs pa rnams kyis skyabs gnas su blta ba'i brgya byin de nyid skyon zad kyi ston pa min par grags pas sgrub pa yin gsungs/ thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das khyed kyi 'bras bu mchog thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang la mnga' brnyes pa'i grags pa dang*/ snyan pa'i sgra chen po brgya byin gyis skad gsang mthon pos sgrogs par gyur to zhes pa ste de ltar grags pa sgrogs tshul dang sgrogs pa po la bltos nas kyang thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das khyad par du 'phags par grub bo// khyab 'jug dag ni nag bkra bos// bred 'thoms gyur nas kun gtong gi / khri yi 'og tu zhugs par gyur*// gtso khyod kun tu bsnyengs mi mnga'// zhes bya ba ni/ khyab 'jug ste kriṣ+ṇa 'am nag po gang gi ni rang gi dgrar gyur pa lha ma yin nag bkra bos dmag drangs nas 'thab pa'i tshe kriṣ+ṇa bred cing dngangs te 'thoms par gyur nas bros te rgyal po'i drang srong kun gtong gi khri'i 'og tu zhugs par gyur ces grags te/ de yang kriṣ+ṇa yul ma thu ra ste bcom brlag tu bsdad/ skabs shig la lha ma yin nag bkra bo zhes bya bas dmag 'bum phrag gsum tsam 'khrid nas yul bcom brlag tu 'ongs pa na/ kriṣ+ṇa rang gcig pu g.yul ngor song ba nag bkra bos mthong nas kho yang gcig pur 'ongs nas phan tshun 'thab pa na nag bkra bo ma thub pas kriṣ+ṇa skrag ste bros/ de'i tshe rgyal po drang srong kun gtong bya bas lha rnams la grogs byas nas lha ma yin dang 'thab pa las lha ma yin pham par byas pa'i bya dgar ngal gso ba'i ched nyal nas rang bsam gyis ma lang gi bar du sus kyang slong mi chog pa'i mchog blangs nas phug pa zhig na nyal khri zhig gi steng du nyal yod pa las kriṣ+ṇa kun gtong gi khri'i 'og tu zhugs nas yibs song*/

nag bkra bos ded nas 'ongs te phugs pa der yod par shes nas skad rgyab pa kun gtong gis thos nas kho khros nas langs te nag bkra bo bsad ces grags so// 'dis ni kriṣ+ṇa yang 'jigs bcas su mu stegs pa rang la grags pa'i gtam rgyud kyis bsgrubs pa yin gsungs/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi gtso bo thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das khyed ni mi 'jigs pa bzhi la mnga' brnyes pas na dus dang rnam pa kun tu phyi'i dgra su gang la yang bsnyengs pa ste skrag pa'am 'jigs pa dang bag tsha ba mi mnga' bas ston pa gzhan las khyad par du 'phags par grub bo// zhes pa'o// skye dgu'i bdag po rang nyid kyi// bu mo dang ni 'khrig ces thos// thub pa khyod kyi slob ma yang*// tshangs par spyod pa skyon ma mchis// zhes bya ba ni/ tshangs pa'i bye brag tshangs pa skye dgu'i bdag po zhes bya ba rang nyid kyi bu mo la chags nas de dang ni 'khrig pa spyad ces rig byed kyi gzhung lugs las thos so// thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das khyod kyis bgrod par bya ba'i gnas min pa la bgrod pa'i spyod pa de lta bu ston pa khyed tsam du ma zad khyod kyi slob ma shā ri'i bu dang*/ moṅgal gyi bu sogs la'ang tshangs par spyod pa skyon dang ldan pa 'ga' yang ma mchis so// zhes pa ste 'dir yang skye dgu'i bdag po la bltos te chags pa bral tshul gyis khyad par du 'phags par bstan to// bram ze rnams ni dge sdig dag /sbyin pa len cing 'pho bar smra// khyod kyi byas pa chud mi za// ma byas pa dang phrad med gsungs// zhes bya ba ni/ rig byed kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i bram ze rnams kyis ni/ dge ba dang sdig pa gang dag gzhan la phar sbyin pa dang rang gis tshul len par 'dod cing gtong len byas na phan tshun du 'pho ba yod par smra'o// thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das khyod kyis ni/ lus can dag gi las rnams ni// bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za// tshogs shing dus la bab pa na// 'bras bu smin pa nyid du 'gyur// zhes las byas pa chud mi za ba dang*/

las ma byas pa dang 'phrad pa nam yang med ces bden pa yang dag pa'i tshig gis gsungs so// zhes pa'o// ser skyas bdag gi mtshan nyid ni// shes dang ldan par rab tu brtags// khyod kyi de ltar yin na bdag /mi rtag nyid dang ldan zhes bstan// zhes bya ba ni/ grangs can rnams kyi gzhung lugs thog ma rtsom pa'i ston pa drang srong ser skya zhes bya bas rtag pa rang byung gi bdag gi mtshan nyid dam rang bzhin ni shes pa dang ldan par rang gis blos rab tu brtags nas smra bar byed do// thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das khyod kyis ni bdag gi rang bzhin shes pa dang ldan pa de ltar yin na khyod kyi lugs la bdag de mi rtag pa ste 'jig pa'i bdag nyid dang ldan par 'gyur ro zhes 'gal bar bstan par mdzad ces pa'o// gzegs zan gyis ni shes las bdag /gzhan dang khyad par yongs su brjod// khyod kyis de ni shes med na// shing dang 'dra bar thal 'gyur gsungs// zhes bya ba ni/ gzegs ma ni chung ngu'i don yin pas zas chung ngu zos nas dka' thub bstan pa'i ston pa gzegs gzan nam gzegs zan gyis ni shes pa las bdag de nyid gzhan du 'dod pa dang bdag de kun la khyab par yongs su brjod do// thub pa sangs rgyas khyod kyis bdag de ni shes pa las gzhan shes pa med pa can zhig yin na/ sems med pa'i shing dang 'dra ba ste khyad par med par thal bar 'gyur ro// zhes log rtog gi brag ri phye mar 'thag pa'i rigs pa'i gnam lcags 'di ltar gsungs zhes pa'o// gcer bus lus kyi tshad bzhin du// srog ni zhum dang rgyas par smra// khyod kyis de ni phyogs gcig phyir// rnam par 'jig par 'gyur zhes gsungs// zhes bya ba ni/ 'doms dkris tsam yang med pa'i mu stegs gcer bu zhes bya bas rig byed bzhi khas mi len cing srog bdag tu 'dod la/ de yang skyes bu rnams kyi lus sam gzugs kyi tshad ji lta ba bzhin du yod pas lus zhum pa'am 'grib par 'gyur ba dang lus rgyas na srog kyang rgyas shing 'phel bar 'gyur ro zhes smra'o// thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis srog nyid bdag yin na bdag de ni lus kyi phyogs gcig yin pa'i phyir lus 'jig pa na bdag de yang 'jig dgos pas khyed cag gi lugs la bdag de nyid rnam par 'jig pa ste mi rtag par 'gyur ro zhes srog bdag tu 'dod na bdag rtag par 'dod pa dang 'gal bar gsungs zhes pa'o//

bram zes 'gro ba rnams kyi rgyu// skyes bu rtag pa yin zhes brtags// khyod kyis rtag pa zhes bya ba'i// rgyu ni ci yang med ces gsungs// zhes bya ba ni/ bram ze ste rig byed khas len pa'i dpyod pa pa dag gis 'gro ba rnams kyi rgyu/ rig byed nas bshad pa'i skyes bu rtag pa zhes bya ba de nyid yin zhes rang rang gi blos brtags nas smra bar byed do// thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das khyed kyis skyes bu rtag pa zhes bya ba 'gro ba'i rgyu de lta bu zhig gi ci yang ste gang yang med ces gsungs zhes pa'o// bdag nyid chen po dug can pa'i// sras po stong phrag drug cu dag / ser skyas bltas pa tsam gyis bsregs// de la'ang khyed ni thugs rje mdzad// ces bya ba ni/ bsam pa rgya che ba'i bdag nyid chen po ste rgyal po dug can pa'i sras po stong phrag drug cu po dag drang srong ser skya khros pa'i mig gis bltas pa tsam gyis bsregs nas lus thal bar byas so// de yang rgyal po dug can pa bya ba zhig la chung ma gnyis yod pa las gcig la bu 'chol ba zhes bya ba dang*/ gcig la bu drug khri yod par grags/ ji tsam na rgyal po des rta'i mchod sbyin gyi rta mang po bsags nas bu drug khri go cha dang bcas srung mar bzhag pa'i tshe khyab 'jug gis rta rnams brkus nas sa 'og tu bros pa bu drug khris thos nas bu rnams sa 'og tu song ba dang ser skya'i gan na rta rnams 'dug pa mthong nas ser skya la brnyas tshul gyis rta rnams phyir 'khyer ba brtsams pa na/ ser skyas rang la brnyas par shes nas khros te mig gis bltas pas bu de thams cad bsregs pa'i lus thal bar song*/ de dag shi nas dmyal bar skyes so// phyi nas 'tshol ba'i bu myur ba dang*/ de'i bu dilīpa zhes pa gnyis kyis khu bo mes po drug khri po de dag dmyal bar skyes pa'i lo rgyus thos nas de dag gi don du lo mang por gaṅgā dbab par dka' thub spyad par brtsams kyang dbab ma nus so// dilīpa kyi bu yin snyam bha gī ra tha ste skal ldan shing rta zhes bya bas tshangs pa dka' thub kyis mgu bar byas pas tshangs pas de la gaṅgā mi'i 'jig rten du 'bab pa'i bka' byin pa na gaṅgā 'gror ma 'dod kyang mes po'i bka' las 'da' ma nus te bsam pa/

'on kyang shugs chen pos song nas sa 'og tu 'jug par bya snyam nas shugs kyis 'bab pa na dbang phyug ma mgu nas gaṅgā rang gi ral pa'i nang du bzhag kyang skal ldan shing rtas dka' thub kyis lha chen mgu bar byas pas ral pa btsir ba dang*/ thigs pa bdun babs pa'i gcig deng sang gi gaṅgā 'di yin gsungs/ de nas ri kha ba can nas rgya mtshor 'bab par rtsom pa na bud med bzhin du sgeg pa'i nyams kyis ca co sgrogs shing dal bar 'bab pa'i sgra ri der drang srong dzah+nu zhes pa rnal 'byor sgom pa zhig yod pa des thos pas kho khros te gaṅgā 'thungs so// yang skal ldan shing rtas drang srong de mnyes par byas pas slar skyugs pa sa 'og tu song nas dug can pa'i bu dmyal bar skyes pa rnams kyi sdig pa'i phung po bkrus nas de rnams dmyal ba las thar te mtho ris su skyes so zhes grags/ de'i phyir snyan ngag me long mar/ dzah+na'i bu mo'i chu gos ni// 'phrog byed rkang pa'i rtser ldan pa// zhes gaṅgā la dza nu'i bu mo zer ba'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin gsungs/
