'dir yang mu stegs pa rnams kyi rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen por khas len pa'i ston pa ser skya zhe sdang can du mu stegs pa rang la grags pa'i lo rgyus las dpog pa ltar yin pas skyon dang bcas par grub pa yin no// de ltar drang srong khros nas bsad pa'i sems can drug khri po de dag ma zad/ gsod pa po'i drang srong zhe sdang gi gzhan dbang du gyur pa'i ser skya de nyid la'ang thabs mkhas shing thugs rje che ba'i thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das khyed ni thugs rje mdzad do// de ltar ser skya zhe sdang dang ldan zhing sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ni de las bzlog ste sems can kun la snyoms pa'i thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa'i khyad par 'phags so// ser skya de nyid rig pas ni// gtso las 'gro ba skye bar bshad// khyod kyis 'gro ba'i skye ba ni// nyon mongs pa las 'byung bar bsgrags// zhes bya ba ni/ grangs can gyi ston pa drang srong ser skya zhes pa de nyid nyi shu rtsa lnga khong du chud cing rig pa des ni spyi gtso bo'am rtsa ba'i rang bzhin las 'gro ba rnams skye bar bshad do// de yang spyir grangs can pa la dbang phyug byed pa po'i lhar khas len pa'i grangs can lha bcas pa dang*/ de las bzlog pa'i grangs can lha med pa gnyis las phyi mas ni byed pa po gtso bo kho nar smra'o// de yang drang srong ser skya'i rjes su 'brangs nas shes bya thams cad/ bdag dang*/ gtso bo dang*/ chen po dang*/ nga rgyal dang*/ gzugs/ sgra/ dri/ ro/ reg bya'i de tsam lnga dang*/ ngag /lag pa/ rkang pa/ rkub/ 'doms kyi dbang po ste las kyi dbang po lnga/ mig /rna ba/ sna/ lce/ lag pa'i dbang po ste blo'i dbang po lnga/ yid kyi dbang po lnga ste dbang po bcu gcig dang*/ sa/ chu/ me/ rlung*/ nam mkha' ste 'byung ba lnga dang bcas pa'i de nyid nyer lngar grangs nges par 'dod/ de las bdag dang skyes bu don gcig cing*/

shes pa dang rig pa 'dod la/ lhag ma nyer bzhi bems po yin zer zhing bdag dang gtso bo gnyis bden pa dang*/ gzhan rnams rdzun pa yin zhes zer to// gtso bo dang rtsa ba'i rang bzhin dang*/ spyi zhes pa don gcig cing*/ rdul mun snying stobs kyi yon tan gsum cha mnyam pa la byed zer/ des na spyi gtso bo'am/ rtsa ba'i rang bzhin las chen po skyes/ de las nga rgyal skyes/ de las rnam 'gyur gzhan rnams skyes par 'dod/ de la rang bzhin ni rgyu'am spyi dang*/ rnam 'gyur ni 'bras bu'am gsal ba zer/ de ltar na mu bzhi ste dbang phyug nag pos/ rtsa ba'i rang bzhin rnam par 'gyur min la// chen po sogs bdun rang bzhin rnam 'gyur zhing*// bcu drug po ni rnam par 'gyur ba ste// skyes bu rang bzhin ma yin rnam 'gyur min// zhes bshad pa ltar ro// thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das khyed kyis 'khor ba'i rgyu rtag pa spyi gtso bo de gtan nas mi srid pas/ 'gro ba rnams 'khor ba'i gnas su skye ba len pa dang 'chi 'pho ba ni/ rang rgyu nyon mongs pa ma rig pa dang sred pa'i dbang gis las bsags pa las byung bar gyur pa yin no// zhes 'khor gyi dbus su seng ge'i sgra chen po bsgrags par mdzad do// de yang rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshul ni 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ dang po brgyad pa dgu nyon mongs// gnyis pa bcu pa las yin te// lhag ma rnams ni sdug bsngal yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar la rten 'brel yag lag bcu gnyis ni/ thog ma'i yan lag ma rig pa/ yan lag gnyis pa 'du byed kyi las/ gsum pa rnam shes/ bzhi pa ming gzugs/ lnga pa skye mched/ drug pa reg pa/ bdun pa tshor ba/ brgyad pa sred pa/ dgu pa len pa/ bcu pa srid pa/ bcu gcig pa skye ba/ bcu gnyis pa rga shi la sogs pa rnams so// ser skya la sogs thar pa yis// bdag ni srid pa'i rgyu zhes zer//

khyod ni zhi bar gshegs gyur nas// zhugs gum lta bu bgrang du med// zhes bya ba ni/ drang srong ser skya dang*/ la sogs pa rjes 'brang dang bcas pas/ thar pa thob pa yi gnas skabs kyi bdag de nyid ni/ srid par 'khyams pa'i gnas skabs su rgyu ba'i bdag de kho na yin no zhes zer ro// thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das khyed kyis ni/ zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i go 'phang dam par gshegs shing zhugs par gyur pa nas 'khor ba'i gnas skabs kyi bdag de nyid zhugs gum pa ste me shi ba lta bur zad cing 'gags nas rtag pa dang mi rtag pa gang du yang bgrang du med ces gsungs zhes pa'o// mu stegs byed pa kha cig ni// thar pa 'gro dang ldan zhes smra// gang la 'gro yod de 'khor ba// khyod kyis thugs su chud nas bstan// ces bya ba ni/ mu stegs byed pa gcer bu pa kha cig gi ni thar pa zhes pa 'jig rten thams cad kyi steng na yod pa 'jig rten gyi khams 'dus pa zhes bya ba gdugs dkar po gyen la bslangs pa lta bu srog yod pas dngos po dang*/ dngos po med pa yang min par 'dod pa de na 'gro ba dang ldan no// zhes smra'o// 'jig rten gang la 'gro ba yod pa de ni 'khor ba yin no// zhes thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das khyed kyis de ltar thugs su chud nas gdul bya la bstan par mdzad do// zhes pa'o// gcer bus kun dga' ra ba sogs// rtsig pa sdig pa'i rgyu zhes zer// thams cad mkhyen pa khyed nyid ni// de nyid bsod nams rgyu zhes gsungs// zhes pa ste/ mu stegs gcer bu pas kun dga' ra ba dang*/ dgon pa sogs rtsig pa'i zhar la 'bu srin sogs shi ba'i phyir na kun dga' ra ba sogs rtsig par byed pa sdig pa'i rgyu yin zer la/ thams cad mkhyen pa khyed nyid kyis ni skye bo mang po la phan pa dang*/ bsod nams gsog pa'i slad du kun dga' ra ba dang*/ dgon pa sogs byed pa na/

kun dga' ra ba gtsug lag khang*// mal stan 'tsho ba nar ma dang*// glo bur nad pa nad g.yog la// yul ngan tshe na sbyin pa ni// rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams bdun// zhes 'byung ba ltar gyi rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams zhes bya ba bdun gyi nang tshan zhig 'byung ba'i rgyur gsungs zhes pa'o// de yang kun dga' ra ba lta bu rtsig pa de nyid zhig nas med par ma gyur gyi bar du byed pa po de la dus rtag tu bsod nams rnam par 'phel bar gsungs/ lus las lus gzhan dag tu ni// phra ba'i srog ni 'pho zhes grag / khyod kyis lus las gzhan gyur pa'i// srog ni yod pa min zhes gsungs// zhes pa ste/ mu stegs gcer bu pa la sogs pas 'chi ba'i dus su tshe 'di'i lus las phyi ma'i lus gzhan dag tu ni phra ba'i srog gam bdag 'pho ba yin zhes grag la/ grag ces pa ma rangs pa'i tshig yin/ thams cad mkhyen pa khyed kyis lus las don gzhan du gyur pa'i 'gro ba'i srog ces pa'i bdag ni yod pa min no zhes gsungs/ zhes so// khros pas g.yul ngor bsad na ni// bde 'gror 'gyur zhes rgyas pa zer// mgon po khyod kyis gnas skabs de'i// sems ni ngan 'gro yin zhes gsungs// zhes pa ste/ khong khro bas dgra sogs g.yul ngor bsad na shi ba po bde 'gror 'gro bar 'gyur zhes drang srong rgyas pa zer la/ de yang rig byed pa'i gzhung du bram ze rnams kyis mi gsod mi rung yang*/ rgyal pos dmag rgyab ste mi gsod par byed na chos yin/ gsod pa po tshe 'dir dgra thul zhing don 'grub pa dang*/ phyi ma mtho ris su skye bas lag pa gnyis kar la du thob pa lta bu dang*/ shi ba por tshe phyi ma mtho ris su 'gro bas lag pa ya gcig na la du thob pa lta bu yin zer ba'i lugs srol ngan pa zhig yod/ mgon po thams cad mkhyen pa khyod kyis khros pas mi gsod pa'i gnas skabs de'i sems la brten nas ngan 'gror skye ba yin zhes phyin ci ma log par gsungs/

zhes pa'o// skya bseng bu ni brjod byas na// bsod nams 'gyur zhes so sor smra// gang zhig bgrod min bgrod byed pa// de dag khyod kyi bstan la smad// ces pa ste/ g.yul ngor brtan dang*/ 'jigs sde/ srid sgrub/ lhar bcas/ rigs med de/ skya bseng gi bu lnga po'i ming brjod par byas na bsod nams 'thob par 'gyur zhing*/ so sor te re re'i ming bton kyang bsod nams 'thob par mu stegs pa dag smra la/ skyes bu gang zhig bgrod bya ma yin pa rang gi spun gyi chung ma sogs la bgrod par byed pa skya bseng gi bu de dag gi ming brjod par byas na bsod nams 'thob rgyu lta zhog /de dag gis log g.yem spyod pa yin pas bcom ldan 'das khyed kyi bstan pa la shin tu smad pa'i gnas yin no// de yang bud med nag mo zhes pa gcig nyid skya bseng gi bu lnga ga'i chung ma yin par mu stegs pas zer la rgya gar na rang gi spun rgan gzhon gyi chung mar mnyam du spyod pa shin tu ma rabs tha chad du brtsi ba yin/ skem byed dbang po nye dbang po// drag po la sogs 'jigs pa dang*// bsdigs phyir mtshon cha rtag tu thogs// khyod bsnyengs bral zhing bsdigs mi mdzad// ces pa ste/ skem byed de lha yi dmag dpon gzhon nu gdong drug dang*/ dbang po brgya byin dang*/ nye dbang khyab 'jug dang*/ drag po dbang phyug la sogs pa rnams rang nyid 'jigs pa las ma grol nas rang la 'jigs pa las srung ba dang*/ gzhan dag la bsdigs pa'am gnod par bya ba'i phyir rim pa bzhin du mdung dang*/ rdo rjes/ 'khor lo/ mda' la sogs pa'i mtshon cha rtag tu thogs la/ bcom ldan 'das khyod ni rang nyid bsnyengs pa'am 'jigs pa kun dang bral zhing gzhan la gnod cing bsdigs par ma mdzad pa'i phyir na rtag tu mtshon cha mi bsnams pa yin no// zhes pa'o// de yang mtshon cha'i dgos don la brtags shing dpyad pa na rang phyogs la gzhan gyis gnod pa las srung ba dang*/

gzhan dag 'joms par byed pa gnyis las ma 'das la/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi chos ni rang gzhan sems can thams cad la gnod pa spong byed kyi thabs dam pa yin pas/ 'dzam gling gi mi mang tshang mas sangs rgyas kyi chos la go ba chags pa zhig byung na rdul phran mtshon cha zer ba sogs 'gog thub kyi red/ 'dir phebs tshang mas chos kyi don rang gis shes nas nyams su len thub pa dang*/ rang gi 'khor du gtogs pa dang*/ nye ba gnyen tshan sogs gzhan dag la rgya gang che spel thabs gnang dgos/ tshang mas khur bsnams te gzab gzab gnang dgos pa red/ khyod ni sus kyang mi bsnyengs la// su la'ang bsdigs par mi mdzad pas// khyod nyid gcig pu mtshon mi bsnams// des na 'gro ba rnams las 'phags// zhes pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das khyed ni sus kyang bsnyengs shing 'jigs par mi byed la/ khyod kyis su la'ang gnod cing bsdigs par mi mdzad pa'i phyir na khyed nyid gcig pu mtshon cha mi bsnams shing*/ des na thams cad mkhyen pa khyed brgya byin dang dbang phyug la sogs pa'i 'gro ba thams cad las khyad par du 'phags pa yin no zhes pa'o// smra po nyon mongs bcas pa'i tshig /rig byed la sogs tshig dag ni// phal cher ltag 'og 'gal ba lags// khyod kyi thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung*// zhes pa ste/ tshig gang zhig smra ba po sems rgyud nyon mongs pa dang bcas pas kun nas bslangs pa'i tshig dper na rig byed pa la sogs pa'i tshig dag ni phal cher ltag 'og gam snga phyi 'gal ba la sogs pa'i skyon dang ldan pa yin la/ mgon po khyod kyi gsung rnams shes bya thams cad ji bzhin mngon sum du mkhyen pa'i gsung nor 'khrul gyi skyon thams cad dang bral ba lags so zhes pa'o// gzhan gyi bstan bcos gzhan dag ni// phal cher snga phyi 'gal ba lags// khyod nyid kyi ni gzhung lugs dag /thog ma bar mthar skyon ma mchis// zhes pa ste/ mu stegs pa gzhan gyi bstan bcos gzhan dag ni phal cher snga phyi 'gal ba la sogs pa'i skyon dang bcas shing*/

mgon po khyod nyid kyi ni gzhung lugs dag ste gsung rab rnams thog ma dang*/ bar dang*/ mtha' mar skyon gtan nas ma mchis pa ste/ dam pa'i chos ni thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge ba/ don bzang po zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar yin zhes pa'o// chos 'dod pa dag dmangs rigs la// blo gros sbyin par bya min ste// khyod ni gdol pa rnams la yang*// thugs rjes dam chos ston par mdzad// ces pa ste/ chos 'dod pa ste bram ze dag gis dmangs rigs rnams la blo gros te rig pa'am chos sbyin cing bslab par bya ba min zer te/ de yang phyi rol rig byed pa'i gzhung du bram ze rnams la chos yongs rdzogs dang*/ rgyal rigs la nyung zad cig /rje'u rigs rnams la de nas nyung ngu zhig bslab rgyu yod cing*/ dmangs rigs la chos dang*/ rig pa gtan nas slob mi rigs/ de bzhin du bud med la'ang chos kyi skal ba gcod kyi yod pa red/ mgon po bcom ldan 'das khyed ni gdol pa la sogs pa'i rigs dang*/ pho mo rnams la yang khyad par med par thams cad la thugs rje chen pos dam pa'i chos ston par mdzad pa yin/ rang ngos nas chos nyan pa'i snod dang ldan na su yin rung dam pa'i chos byed chog pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i gnas mtho shos dge slong gi bslab pa lta bu yang*/ bud med la dge slong ma bsgrub tu gnang yod/ rgya gar gzhung nas kyang phyi pa'i chos de dang po nas rigs sogs mang po phye ste/ 'khrug long gi son rtsa lta bu dang*/ nang chos kyi 'gro lugs 'di khong tsho'i dmangs gtso'i srid lugs dang mthun po yag po zhig tu mthong nas nang chos la dmigs bsal rogs ram 'dra dang dga' bo byed kyi yod pa red/ ljon shing bzang po rnams spangs nas// ngan pa la ni su zhig brten// 'dod chags bral brnyes khyed bzhugs na// mkhas pa su zhig ston gzhan 'dud// ces gsungs te/ me tog dang 'bras bu sogs phun sum tshogs pa'i ljon shing bzang po rnams spangs pa ste dor nas ljon shing ngan pa la ni skye bo su zhig gis kyang brten par mi byed pa de bzhin du 'dod chags bral ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang brnyes pa khyed bzhugs na ste yod bzhin du/

tshul dang tshul min la mkhas pa su zhig gis mu stegs pa'i ston pa gzhan la 'dud cing ston par byed de mi byed ces pa'o// ser skyas yul rnams la spyad bzhin// ye shes 'gyur mchi sdig bral ba// khyod kyis kun nas nyon mongs la// thar pa ga la yod ces gsungs// zhes gsungs te/ grangs can gyi ston pa drang srong ser skyas/ de nyid nyi shu lnga shes na// ral pa mgo rdum cod pan gyis// gnas ni gang dang gar gnas kyang*// grol 'gyur 'di la the tshom med// ces 'dod pa'i yul rnams la longs spyad bzhin du ye shes sam thar pa 'thob par 'gyur ba mchi zer la/ sdig pa thams cad dang bral ba mgon po khyod kyis kun nas nyon mongs pa dang ma bral ba la thar pa 'thob pa ga la yod de med ces gsungs pa'o// bsod nams byas pa'i tshogs dag ni// sems can rnams la yongs bsngo bar// bcom ldan khyod kyis gang gsungs pa// de bzhin bstan bcos las ma bshad// ces gsungs te/ sgo gsum gyis bsod nams mngon par 'du byas pa'i dge ba'i tshogs dag ni/ sems can thams cad la blos btang ste phan pa'i rgyur smon lam gyis yongs su bsngo dgos par mgon po khyed kyis gang gsungs pa de 'dra mu stegs pa gzhan gyi bstan bcos dag las nam yang ma bshad ces pa'o//

de yang rang cag rnams kyis slob sbyong dang dge sbyong gang byed kyang sbyor ba sems bskyed dam pa dang*/ dngos gzhi dmigs med dam pa/ rjes bsngo ba dam pa ste dam pa gsum ldan du bya dgos par gsungs/ lha rten dang ni mchod sbyin la// sems can gsod par byed pa gang*// 'jig rten pa ni chos su 'tshal// khyod kyi bstan la de dag smad// ces gsungs te/ ma hā kā lī lta bu'i lha rten gyi mdun du dang ni mchod sbyin gyi don la sems can gsod par byed pa'i las gang yin pa de/ 'jig rten phyi rol pa ni chos su 'dod la/ thugs rje mnga' ba mgon po khyod kyi bstan pa la sems can gsod pa la sogs pa'i las de dag shin tu smad cing spang bar bya ba yin zhes pa'o// de yang phyi rol pa'i gzhung du mchod sbyin gyi ched du rta dang*/ glang dang*/ ra lug la sogs pa'i srog chags mang po gsod par byed pa chos su smra zhing*/ mi gcig bsad na ra lug bcu drug gi go chod zer/ sā dhu gcig gis kho rang gi sbyin bdag pho mo gnyis lha mo nag mo mjal du 'gro zhes kho rang sdod sa'i nags gseb lha mo nag mo'i sku 'dra yod sa der khrid de/ khyod gnyis mig btsum ste lha mo la gsol ba rtse gcig tu thob zer nas khyim bdag gnyis de ltar sdod skabs sā dhu des ral gris khyim bdag gnyis kyi ske bcad nas bsad pa red/ de yang lo bzhi tsam gyi sngon du yin pa red/ khyim bdag de gnyis nam rgyun sā dhu der dad gus cha 'jog chen po byed mkhan zhig red/ gang zhig srog chags la rtag gnod// de la chos nyid ga la yod// gtso bo khyod kyis rang nyid kyi// srog gis sems can legs par bsrungs// zhes pa ste/ mu stegs pa gang zhig gis srog chags la dus rtag tu gnod pa byed pa'i gang zag de la 'og nas 'chad 'gyur gyi dam pa'i chos lnga po rnams ga la yod de med pa'i phyir zhes dang*/

rkang gnyis rnams kyi gtso bo ston pa khyod kyis gzhan la gnod pa cung zad kyang mi byed pa ma zad skyes rabs nas ji ltar 'byung ba ltar rang nyid kyi srog gis sems can rnams legs par bsrungs pa'i sgo nas khyad par du 'phags so// shākya'i rgyal rigs 'khrungs khyod kyis// gang zhig bden dang mi slu dang*// tshangs par spyod dang dul ba dang*// brtse ldan dam chos lags par dgongs// zhes pa ste/ shākya'i rgyal po'i rigs su 'khrungs pa khyod kyis ni bden pa dang*/ mi slu ba dang*/ tshangs par spyod pa dang*/ dul ba dang*/ brtse ba ldan pa de ni dam pa'i chos lnga po lags pa ste yin par dgongs shing mkhyen pas khyad par du 'phags so// mang bkur nas sras sgra gcan 'dzin gyi bar rgyal po 900643tsam yod 'dra'o// bden pa ni gnyis dang bzhi dang*/ mi slu ba ni rang nyid kyis ji ltar gzigs pa'i don de nyid sems can rnams la ji ltar bstan pa ltar blang dor 'jug ldog gi gnas la mi slu ba'o// tshangs par spyod pa ni so sor thar pa ris brgyad lta bu dang*/ dul ba ni lus ngag yid gsum dul ba zhig dgos kyang gtso bo ni sems dul ba nyid legs pa ste zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar sems dul ba nyid la byed dgos so// brtse ldan gang zag yin kyang skabs 'dir brtse ba nyid la byed dgos pa'o// rig byed mtha' la 'byams pas kyang*// g.yul ngor dgra mngon 'ongs bsad ces// 'jig rten smra yi khyod kyis ni// dgra la'ang snying rje bya zhes gsungs// zhes pa ste/ rig byed mtha' pa'am dpyod pa pa phyi ma ni rig byed kyi grub mtha' la 'byams pa ste mkhas kyang g.yul ngor dgra bo mtshon thogs pa mngon par 'ongs te rgol ba na dgra bo de nyid gsad na bde 'gror 'gro zhes 'jig rten pa rnams la smra yi/ ston pa khyod kyis ni sems can thams cad la sras sgra gcan 'dzin bzhin du gzigs shing sku la tsan dan gyi byug pa dang*/

sta res bsnun pa'i sems can la thugs snyoms pas 'gro ba gzhan lta zhog dgra la'ang thugs mi 'khrug pa ma zad snying rje bya dgos zhes gsungs pas sems can gzhan la mi 'tshe ba'i sgo nas khyad par du 'phags so// gzhon nus rang gi zhang po la// mdung gis bsnun zhes bka' mchid gda'// dpa' bo khyod kyis nyon mongs pa'i// drwa ba shes rab mtshon gyis dral// zhes pa ste/ gzhon nu gdong drug gis dgra dang bar ma lta zhog rang gi zhang po ri ngur pa la 'phang mdung gis bsnun pa yin zhes bka' mchid de sngon gyi gtam rgyud du yod pa dang*/ bdud bzhi bcom pa'i dpa' bo khyod kyis gzhan la gnod pa med par nyon mongs pa'i drwa ba shes rab mtshon gyis dral ba nyon mongs spangs pas khyad par du 'phags so// khyab 'jug gis ni rang nyid kyi// slas kyang yongs su bskyab ma nus// gtso bo khyod kyis sems can kun// bskyab pa'i don du rtag tu btson// zhes pa ste/ khyab 'jug gis ni dgra dang bar ma lta zhog rang gi btsun mo dang gnyen 'dun rnams kyang drang srong gis dmod pa'i mthu las yongs su bskyabs ma nus shing*/ gtso bo khyod kyis sems can kun bskyab pa'i don du dus rtag tu brtson 'grus rtsom pas khyad par du 'phags so// rgan pos sbyar ba'i 'jigs shes nas// khyab 'jug gis ni bcom brlag btang*// thub pa khyod la bsnyengs bgyid gang*// sems can de ni 'ga' ma mchis// zhes pa ste/ khyab 'jug gis ma gadha'i rgyal po rgan pos sbyar ba'i bu mo btsun mor song ba'i rgyal po bsad pa na rgyal pos de'i lan du dmag drangs pa la khyab 'jug gam kriṣ+ṇa 'jigs nas rang gi grong khyer bcom brlag blos btang nas lho phyogs su bros pa dang*/ thub pa khyod la ni bsnyengs par bgyid pa ste skrag par byed pa'i sems can su yang med pas 'jigs nas bros pa 'ga' yang med pas khyad par 'phags so//

khyab 'jug gis ni gnyen 'dun dag /le lan gyis ni gtugs par gyur// khyod kyis gnyen 'dun thams cad ni// 'khor ba las ni rnam par sgrol// zhes pa ste/ khyab 'jug gi ni rang gi gnyen 'dun thams cad drang srong gis dmod pa dor ba'i le lan gyis gtugs shing zad par gyur la/ thub pa khyod kyis sras sgra gcan 'dzin dang*/ kun dga' bo dang*/ grags 'dzin ma la sogs pa'i gnyen 'dun phal mo che 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa las skyob cing rnam par sgrol bar mdzad pas khyad par du 'phags pa ma zad skye dgu'i bdag mo yang rab tu byung nas dgra bcom mar gyur te bud med kyi tshogs la chos kyis phan thogs chen po byas yod pa dang*/ grags 'dzin ma rab tu byung ste/ dge slong mar gyur nas chos kyis phan pa chen po byung ba dang*/ sras sgra gcan 'dzin kyang rab tu byung nas 'phags pa gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i sde pa'i mkhan brgyud mdzad nas 'dul ba'i bstan pa rgya cher dar bar mdzad pa dang*/ rig byed nas bud med la chos ston pa bkag kyang nang pa'i chos la nam yang ma bkag par skyes pa dang bud med gnyis chos kyis sgor 'jug chog pa la khyad par 'ga' yang med ces gsungs so// mu stegs can gyi gzhung lugs la// ji lta ji ltar rnam bsams pa// de lta de ltar mgon khyod la// bdag gi sems ni dad par gyur// ces pa ste/ nang pa las gzhan phyi rol mu stegs pa ste lta ba ngan pa'i mu la thar par bgrod pa'i lam gyi stegs 'cha' ba rnams kyi gzhung lugs la ji lta ji ltar rigs pas rnam par dpyad cing bsams pas mi bden pa ste slar yang bdag lta brtan par byed pa'i rgyu las bdag lta gtan nas zad pa'i thabs gang yang ma bstan cing*/ rigs pa dang 'gal zhing dpyad mi bzod pa dang*/ thub pa'i bstan pa ni phas kyi rgol ba mtha' dag 'joms shing grub pa'i mtha' gang la 'gal 'du med cing skye dgu'i don thams cad bde blag tu ster ba de lta de ltar mthong bas rgyu mtshan de nyid kyis mgon po khyod la mtho btsun grub rje bdag gis sems rnam pa kun tu dad par gyur ces pa'o//

dad pa'i dbye ba sogs mang du gsungs nas dad pa yon tan kun gyi rtsa ba yin pa dang*/ mnyam med thub pa'i dbang pos kyang chos snang ba'i sgo brgya rtsa brgyad kyi thog mar dad pa gsungs pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pas/ legs byin gcig tu dgos pa'i chos ni gang*/ thar pa'o// de la dgos pa gang*/ dad pa'o zhes dri ba de'i lan thebs pas de bzhin gshegs pa mnyes nas bsnyen par rdzogs par gsungs pa ltar mtha' gcig tu phan pa'i thabs kyang dad pa nyid la gsungs pa dang*/ de bzhin du dad pa sngon 'gro ma ltar zhes gsungs so// de ltar thams cad mkhyen min pa'i// grub mtha'i skyon gyi brlag sems ldan// bsam brlag rnams kyis skyon med pa'i// ston pa khyod kyang mi mthong ngo*// zhes pa ste/ sngar ji skad bshad pa de ltar grub mtha' smra ba po thams cad mkhyen pa ma yin pa'i bshad pa'i rang rang gi grub mtha'i skyon gyis brlag sems ldan pa ste/ de la zhugs pa'i gang zag rnams kyi bsam pa brlag pa ste bsam pa stor ba yin pa de ltar bsam brlag ste bsam pa stor ba rnams kyis skyon cung zad kyang med pa'i bstan pa ma zad ston pa bcom ldan 'das khyod kyang mi mjal ba'am mi mthong ngo*// 'jig rten lha dang bram ze dang*// rig byed shākya 'di dag ces// sdang bar smra ba rang skyon nyid// ci phyir sems par byed ce na// zhes pa ste/ skye 'jig can gyi phung po la brten nas btags pa'i lha dang*/ bram ze dang rig byed smra ba dang shākya smra ba can 'di dag ces nang pa sangs rgyas pa rnams kyis bkag nas sdang bar byas so zhes smra ba ni grub mtha' rang la de lta bu'i skyon yod pa yin te/ dper na/ me yis rdo mi sreg cing bud shing sreg pa ni bud shing rang la sreg pa'i skyon tshang ba'i dbang gis yin pa bzhin no// ci'i phyir sems par byed ce na zhes pa ste rgyu mtshan ci'i phyir khyod kyi bstan pa la dad cing sems par byed ces 'dri na/

gang slad khyod kyi bstan pa ni// bde bas bde nyid thob bgyid pa// de slad smra ba'i seng khyod kyi// gzhung lugs la ni 'gro 'di dga'// zhes pa ste/ de ltar gong du bshad pa ltar khyod kyi bstan pa la sems shing dga' ba rgyu mtshan gang gi phyir zhe na/ dper na/ snang ba nas snang ba'i mthar thug par 'gro ba dang*/ snang ba nas mun par 'gro ba dang*/ mun pa nas mun pa'i mthar thug par 'gro ba dang*/ mun pa nas snang bar 'gro ba rnams su yod pa las 'dir snang ba nas snang ba'i mthar thug tu 'gro ba ltar bde ba'i lam bzang po gcig nas gcig tu brgyud de bde ba bla na med pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang du 'gro ba de'i phyir/ rang gzhan su la yang smra ba'i 'jigs pa med pa'i seng chen thub pa khyod kyi gzhung lugs la ni 'gro ba 'di dag yid rab tu dga'o// khyod kyi yon tan yang dag pa// rnam pa 'di ltar rab brjod pas// bdag gis bsod nams gang thob des// 'gro ba'i 'jig rten khyod 'drar shog / ces pa ste/ thub pa khyod kyi yon tan yang dag pa gong du bshad pa'i rnam pa de ltar rab tu brjod pas mtho btsun grub rje bdag gis bsod nams gang bsags pa'am thob pa de la brten nas khams gsum kun tu 'gro ba'i skye 'jig can gyi phung po la brten pa'i sems can ma lus pa thub pa khyod ltar ram khyed 'drar shog ces pa'o// mgon po khyad par 'phags bstod pa// bton pa dag gis dge bsags pa// gang yin des ni 'gro ba kun// byang chub lam la gzhol gyur cig / mu stegs pa'i ston pa dang*/ de'i bstan pa dang grogs dge 'dun rnams las nang pa'i ston pa dang de'i bstan pa dang dam chos tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i grogs 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams khyad par du 'phags pa'i bstod pa cung zad ngag nas bton pa mtho btsun grub rje bdag gis dge ba bsags pa gang yin pa de dag thams cad kyis ni 'gro ba kun bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi lam la gzhol bar gyur cig ces pa'o//

khyad par du 'phags pa'i bstod pa slob dpon mtho btsun grub rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// khyad par du 'phags pa'i bstod pa 'di slob dpon mtho btsun grub rjes mdzad pa dang lha las phul byung gis bstod pa slob dpon bde byed bdag pos mdzad pa'o// slob dpon de gnyis dbang phyug chen po la mchog tu dad pa'i bram ze'i rigs su 'khrungs pa'i spun gnyis kyis phyi nang gi bstan bcos thams cad la mkhas par gyur nas/ 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag cag gi khyim na dbang phyug chen po mchod la sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab ni phul du byung bar snang na/ de gnyis gang khyad par du 'phags pa brtag par bya'o snyam nas ri bo ti ser song ba'i tshe dbang phyug chen po lha mo u ma 'khor dang bcas pas ma dros mtsho nas rdzu 'phrul gyi phebs pa'i dgra bcom pa lnga brgya la mchod pa dang*/ bsnyen bkur tshad med pa byas nas chos nyan pa mthong ba dang*/ dbang phyug chen pos kyang de gnyis la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ni 'jig rten gsum gyi bla ma dam pa yin pas de dang de'i gsung rab la mchod par bya'o zhes smras pa thos nas slar yang rang yul du 'ongs te nang pa'i bstan par zhugs shing rab tu byung nas bstod pa 'di byas so// phyi rol pa'i lha dang ston pa las nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i ston pa dang bstan pa dam pa'i chos dang dge 'dun bcas khyad par du 'phags pa'i tshul brjod pa'i sgo nas bstod pa/ bram ze'i rigs su sku 'khrungs pa'i 'phags yul gyi slob dpon mtho btsun grub rje zhes bya bas mdzad pa yongs su rdzogs so// zhes mdzad byang ngo// rgya gar gyi mkhas pa sarba dzñā de wa ste thams cad mkhyen pa'i lha dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de'am btsun pa rin chen mchog gis bsgyur/ slad kyi ban+de'am btsun pa dpal brtsegs rak+ṣi tas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan pa phab pa'o// rgya gar nub phyogs khu nur sku bltams pa mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po bla ma bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan rin po che mchog nas/

ma su rir gtsug lag slob dpon rnams la/ 'phags yul gyi slob dpon mtho btsun grub rjes mdzad pa'i khyad par 'phags bstod kyi bshad 'khrid dgyes bzhin du bstsal skabs kyi zin bris rtsa 'grel sbrags ma 'di bzhin bal yul karma legs bshad gling nas par du bskrun pa dge'o// ༈ oṃ swasti sid+dhi rastu/ deng 'dir gsung rab rin chen 'phrul par du// bzhengs dges legs byas 'dis mtshon dus gsum du// bgyis pa'i dge tshogs dri ma med pa rnams// gcig tu bsdoms te mthun rkyen sgrub rnams dang*// bstan pa'i sbyin bdag tshe ring 'byor ldan zhing*// ma gyur nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam 'gro ba kun// sgrib gnyis byang zhing tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs te// bla med rnam grol thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo// bstan 'dzin dam pa gang na su bzhugs rnams// sku tshe'i rkyen gegs tha dag rab zhi nas// bstan 'gro'i don chen bla med mdzad bzhin du// dam chos bdud rtsi'i sbrang char 'bebs gyur cig /yangs pa'i rgyal khams kun tu lo legs shing*// nad mug 'khrug rtsod thams cad zhi ba dang*// mi mthun rgud pa'i ming yang mi grags par// rdzogs ldan dang po'i lang tsho 'char bar shog /de'i mthus kha ba ris pa'i skye dgu'i yid// rnam dkar dge ba'i las la phyogs pa dang*// mthun rkyen legs tshogs gong nas gong 'phel te// dam chos 'dzin pa'i snod du rung bar shog /'jig rten dbang phyug phyag na pad+mo yi// zhabs pad bho ṭa'i ljongs 'dir myur bkod de// zhi bsil chos kyi bdud rtsi'i zil mngar ror// longs su spyod pa'i skal bzang myur 'char shog /khyad par bstan pa'i snying po sgrub brgyud kyi// ring lugs dri med sa chen yongs khyab ste// bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams// sku tshe mi 'gyur tshe lha'i ngo bor brtan// phrin las mi zad nyi zla'i 'od dang sdeb// 'dus tshogs dge 'dun bgrang yas rgyu skar la// zab rgyas chos kyi gru char 'bebs par shog
/lha rnams mkha' la shis pa'i glu dbyangs len// 'gro rnams bde zhing skyid pa'i yun du 'tsho// klu rnams dga' bas nor 'dzin dbyig gis bkang*// mthar thug sangs rgyas ye shes thob par shog /
